SMALL LAMP FOR ALL EASY!
THEN MEDIUM FOR ALL MEDIUM!
THEN LARGE FOR ALL HARD!
THEN HUGE FOR ALL ELITE!
So I can now buy a huge lamp from Aris when I complete my quest.
YES!

conversations.section: Standard dialogue

pages.x: Can I help you?
Yes, who are you?
I'm one of Trader Stan's crew; we are all part of the largest fleet of trading and sailing vessels to ever sail the seven seas.
If you want to get to a port in a hurry then you can charter one of our ships to take you there - if the price is right...
So, where exactly can I go with your ships?
We run ships from Port Phasmatys over to Port Tyras, stopping at Port Sarim, Catherby, Brimhaven, Karamja, the Shipyard, Oo'glog and Port Khazard.
We might dock at Mos Le'Harmless once in a while, as well, if you catch my meaning...
Wow, that's a lot of ports. I take it you have some exotic stuff to trade?
We certainly do! We have access to items bought and sold from around the world.
Would you like to take a look?

o: Isn't it tricky to sail about in those clothes?

pages.x: Yes.
No.
Well, that's fine, would you like to charter a ship instead?

o: Yes, I would like to charter a ship.

pages.x: Isn't it tricky to sail about in those clothes?
Tricky? Tricky!
With all due credit, Trader Stan is a great employer, but he insists we wear the latest in high fashion even when sailing.
Do you have even the slightest idea how tricky it is to sail in this stuff?
Some of us tried tearing it and arguing that it was too fragile to wear when on a boat, but he just had it enchanted to re-stitch itself.
It's hard to hate him when we know how much he shells out on this gear, but if I fall overboard because of this getup one more time, I'm going to quit.
Wow, that's kind of harsh.

conversations.section: Standard dialogue, after TokTz-Ket-Dill

pages.x: You need help, [Title]-[Caste]-Player?
Who are you again?
It surprises TzHaar-Mej-Kol that JalYt does not know. I am the TzHaar who organised the very successful Haar-UlTz rework project.
All of the TzHaar stood in awe of TzHaar-Mej-Kol's ideas!
Hmm. No, I have never of the Haar-UlTz project before.
I cannot understand how you have missed it, JalYt. A fine project it was.
What was it, then?
If I remember right - and I do - it was a cold day 104 years ago and TzHaar-Ket-Mej had, had long day watch spawn pool.
It was two days after TzHaar-Ket-Kad stopped lesser demon attack on front gate. Lesser Demon was not very dangerous but it was fine gate.
TzHaar-Mej-Kol think TzHaar-Hur-Bol craft it. Yes, same TzHaar-Hur who craft weapon rack for TzHaar-Xil-Lur. TzHaar-Xil-Lur was lot of trouble.
Good hunter, but lots of trou-
Forget that I asked!
TzHaar-Mej-Kol does not forget. What else do you want to know?

o: What did you call me earlier?

pages.x: That was it.
Well, yes, I suppose I am...
Then you [Title]-[Caste]!

conversations.section: In Al Kharid / Talking to him

pages.x: A thousand greetings, [sir/madam].

o: Could you sell me a dragon scimitar?
What do you think of Ali Morrisane?

pages.x: Do you want to trade?
Yes, certainly. I deal in scimitars.
Nice cloak.
Thank you.
Could you sell me a dragon scimitar?
A dragon scimitar? A DRAGON scimitar?
No way, [man/lady]!
The banana-brained nitwits who make them would never dream of selling any to me.
Seriously, you'll be a monkey's uncle before you'll ever hold a dragon scimitar.
Perhaps you'd like to take a look at my stock?
Not today, thank you.
What do you think of Ali Morrisane?
He is a dangerous man.
Although he does not appear to be dangerous, he has brought several men to this town who have threatened me and several others.
One man even threatened me with a hammer, saying that when he set up his smithy, my shoddy workmanship would be revealed!
What will you do about these threats?
Oh, I am quite confident in the quality of my work... as will you be if you take a look at my wares.
Would you like to see them?
Not today, thank you.

conversations.section: After doing the Grand Exchange tutorial

pages.x: Hi.
Hello, chum, fancy buyin' some designer jewellery? They've come all the way from Ardougne! Most pukka!
erm, no. I'm all set, thanks.
Okay, chum, so what can I do for you? I can tell you the very latest herb prices, or perhaps I could help you decant your potions.
Who are you?
Why, I'm Bob! Your friendly seller of smashin' goods!
So what do you have to sell?
Oh, not much at the moment. Cuz, ya know. Business being so well and cushie.
You don't really look like you're being so successful.
You plonka! It's all a show, innit! If I let people knows I'm in good business they'll want a share of the moolah!
You conveniently have a response for everything.
That's the Ardougne way, my son.

o: Can you decant some potions for me?
Help me out with the prices for herbs?
Tell me the cost to decant potions?
Tell me what I can do with empty vials?

pages.x: If you want potions decanted into 4, 3, 2 or 1 dose versions, I charge 2 coins for each normal vial, 2 coins for each juju vial and 2 coins for each powerburst vial.
Can you tell me what I can do with empty vials?
Why certainly! When you finish your last dose you can either keep the vial or simply throw it out!

pages.i: When finishing the last dose, what would you like to do?

pages.x: Buying bananas, then?
What?
You know, split? Banana? Banana split?
Hahaha. No wait. That's not funny.

conversations.section: Additional conversations

pages.x: Good day, brother. How are the visions?
Still calamitous in the extreme! But what can I do for you?

o: I need to ask you about these demons.
Can I ask you something else?

pages.x: Of course. Ask away.
Certainly. What can I do for you?

o: Is there a reward for killing the demons?

pages.x: I am but a humble monk, although I have occasionally been stricken with visions such as these in the past.
I believe I have been chosen as a conduit for Saradomin to warn others of impending disasters.
My brothers do not listen to me much, however, as I was once struck down with the most fearsome ergotism. They fear my mind has become addled as a result.
Thankfully, the clouds of shrieking bats that live under my bed assure my I am well again, and that the visions I have are true.
Um...
I have also spent many long hours poring over arcane tomes held in the monastery. From this I have learned much of the demon slayers of Saradomin and the threat we face.
Well, the obvious reward is that you will become a spiritual protector of the world.
But what else can I get out of it?
The demons will come arrayed with a collection of minions which will drop various items on death.In addition, the demon general will no doubt have quite valuable items that can be looted.
In addition, it is said that in the 3rd Age, Saradomin blessed demon slayers with a suit of magical armour that made them more deadly to demons.
There is a chance that should you help to slay the beast then you may be rewarded with a piece of this legendary armour yourself!
Be wary of the demons, my child! Be wary!
Be wary of the demons, my child! Be wary!

conversations.section: Talking to Cait / After completing A Christmas Reunion / During a Christmas event

pages.x: Hi there Cait!
Hi Player! How can I help?

o: What can you tell me about pixies?
Can I change the pixie's uniforms?

pages.x: What are you up to now that the workshop is in production?
Currently I'm working on the shift schedule for our next week of toy-making. After that I need to do an inventory count.
That doesn't sound particularly thrilling.
Not everything about Christmas is, I'm afraid!
What can you tell me about your kind? I don't really know much about them, other than your history of working with Diango.
Well, if I had to generalise... We're hardworking, easily excitable, and love long walks in the forest!
How come I don't see any around Gielinor?
We don't go to Gielinor very often, and when we do, we prefer to hide from outsiders. Hence your need for my magical thingymabob.
Our ancestors are originally from Cheanannais, but our main home is actually here on Renmark, in the Enchanted Valley.
Oh! So the Land of Snow is close to home?
Closer than Gielinor, that's for sure.
Though long distances aren't really a problem when you have fairy rings - one moment you're at home, the next you're here, skiing down a hill alongside yetis!
I'm not sure if that sounds terrifying or exhilarating.
Can I change the pixie's uniforms?
Sure! Which colour would you like them to wear?
Nevermind.
Bye for now.
Happy holidays!

conversations.section: Standard dialogue / With the little book o'piracy or having completed Rocking Out

pages.x: I got fish, you got gold?

o: Yes, but I don't want your fish.

pages.x: Yes.
Yes, but I don't want your fish.
Then what are ye doin' in a fish shop? Looking fer work?
Possibly, do you have any quests?
I dunno, I haven't gone through the last catch yet. What sort of fish is it?
A quest isn't a type of fish!
Then I don't have any, and yer wastin' my time!
What happened to your legs?
Ye wanna know what happened to my legs?
Yer too much of a lilly-livered, hat wearin' landlubber to know what happened to my legs!
No I'm not! I've seen some freaky stuff! I can take it!
All right, [lad/lass], since yer so insistent, I'll tell ye.
See, I was clingin' onto a barrel, me ship havin' just had an encounter with this albatross.

How did you survive?
A passin' ship saw the sharks and knew there would be survivors in the water. They sent a longboat and picked me up, but not before the sharks had taken off my legs.
And that [lad/lass] is why they call me two feet Charley, because they found me jammed two feet down a shark's throat.
I think I'm gonna be sick...
I knew ye couldn't handle the truth!

conversations.section: 2017 Halloween event / After collecting nine of the stories

pages.x: Excellent. You have found all nine stories I required...but a story without audience is not a story at all.

In 'Asleep', what was written on the wall?
In 'By Light of the Moon', who was the werewolf?
In 'Clockwork', where was the child found?
In 'Family Reunion', what was the nickname of the dead girl?
In 'Heralds of the Apocalypse', which of the heralds calls Forinthry home?
In 'Saradomin Have Mercy', what was being tested...and slowly lost?
In 'The Group Gatestone', on which floors were people trapped?
In 'Wool', what was the name of the taxidermist?

conversations.section: Conversations / Player Owned Head

pages.x: You deaded me!
Well, yes.
What did you do that for?
A Slayer Master told me to.
Why do the Slayer Masters all pick on poor cockatrice?
They pick on lots of other creatures too.
Then mount one of them on your wall and let poor cockatrice rest in peace!
So I could mount your head on my wall.
Another cockatrice falls victim to the dreaded mirror shield!

You dirty rotten swine, you!
Steady on.
I will kill you with my paralyzing-type magic eyes look!

Concentrates mental power. Eyes narrow beak clenches veins on head stand out.

STRA-A-AIN!
think I'll leave it to you.

conversations.section: Before The Dig Site / East

pages.x: Hello!

What do you do here?
Well, my job involves digging for finds, cleaning them and transporting them for identification.
Sounds interesting.
I find it very interesting and very rewarding. So glad to see you're taking an interest in the site. Hope to see you out here digging sometime!
I'm not sure.
Well, let me know when you are and I'll do my very best to help you!
Can I dig around here?
You can only use a site you have the appropriate exam level for.

Why, you wear them. When you activate one, the magical energy will create a wondrous and very visible glow.

Each is unique! Some aid you with combat, some with training. I even heard of one which turned cannonballs into squid!

I'm also offering a special guarantee: the auras are enchanted so that, if you lose one, just come back to me and I'll return it to you!
Xuan has handed me a vast range of outfits from around the world - finely crafted armours, party costumes and just a few oddities.

conversations.section: With tea in backpack

pages.x: Ooh - that looks like a lovely cup of tea, dearie. Is it for me?

o: No, keep your hands off my tea.
pages.i: What would you like to say?

pages.x: Yes, you can have it.
Ahh, there's nothing like a nice cuppa tea. I know what, I'll tell you a story to thank you for the lovely tea...
A long time ago, when I was a little girl, there was a handsome young man living in Varrock. I saw him here in the church quite often.
Everyone said he was going to become a priest, and we girls were so sad about that.
But young Dissy - that was the young man's nickname - he was a wild young thing.
One night he gathered some lads together, and after the evening prayer-meeting they all put on masks and sneaked down to the evil temple in the south of the city, the evil one.
The next day, there was quite a hubbub. The guards told us that someone had painted 'Saradomin pwns' on the wall of the Zamorakian temple!
Now, we'd always been taught to keep well away from that dreadful place, but it really did us all good to see someone wasn't afraid of the scum who live at that end of town.
Old Father Packett was furious, but Dissy just laughed it off.
Dissy left town after that, saying he wanted to see the world. It was such a shame, he had the most handsome shoulders...
A young man came here looking for stories about Dissy - of course, that's not his proper name, but his friends called him Dissy - and I told him that one.
He said Dissy had become a really famous man and there was going to be a book about him.
Well, that's all good, but I do wish Dissy had just come back to Varrock. I did miss him so much...
well, until I met my Freddie and we got married, but that's another story.
Thank you. I'll leave you to your knitting now.
No, keep your hands off my tea.
Aww. Maybe another time. Anyway, what can old Elsie do for you?

Can you tell me how to get rich?

pages.x: Can you tell me a story?

conversations.section: At the Grand Exchange

pages.x: Hello, [sir/madam]. My name is Giles. Would you like to learn about bank notes?

pages.i: Would you like to learn about bank notes?

pages.x: Very good, [sir/madam].
Bank notes are pieces of paper that represent an item that can be bought or sold.
You can withdraw many items from your own bank in note form, so long as that item can be traded and does not normally stack.
To do so, click in the bank note toggle button and then withdraw your items as normal.
Conversely, you can move any bank notes from your inventory back into your bank. The simple act of doing so will store the actual item in your bank.
Okay, so bank notes are just representations of objects?
Indeed! Now, these 'noted' versions of items cannot be used as could the item itself be - they are, after all, just pieces of paper.
So what are bank notes good for, then?
Mostly for moving items around in bulk.
You see, with some items, you are only able to carry as many as will fit in your inventory - for example, you can typically only carry twenty-eight logs, fish or pieces of ore at a time.
But bank notes stack, so you are able to carry hundreds, thousands or even millions of the same item at once, and all taking up just one space in your inventory.

Bank notes can be traded with other adventurers or sold on the Grand Exchange; moved back and forth between your inventory and bank as you see fit, or even just dropped if you're cleaning your bank of junk.
Even some monsters are known to drop certain items in bank note form.
Anything else I should know?
Just one more point - because noted items hold the same value as the items they represent, you will find that you can trade them for certain goods and services.
For example, farming patch gardeners will accept crop-tending payments in the form of bank notes, and you can use noted ore to load the smelter in the Artisan's Workshop in Falador.
You can even cast the Low and High-Level Alchemy spells on bank notes and you'll create the same amount of coins as you'd have got from casting the spell on the item itself!
Wow, they sound pretty useful. Thanks for the info!
You are most welcome, [sir/madam]. Good day to you.
Very good, [sir/madam].

conversations.section: In the Port Sarim jail / During the Port Sarim Invasion / First time talking to him

pages.x: Hey, what's going on here? Can I help?
Certainly! We'll take all the help we can get, right now.

o: If the initial 200 tokens haven't been claimed:

pages.x: Here, take these!
What do you need help with?
We're under attack by a bunch of pirates called the Skulls, led by the notorous Jed - otherwise known as the Iron Link.
That guy? I have some unfinished business with him. He tried to kidnap a bunch of people not long ago, but Meg and I put a stop to it.
Well, I put a stop to it and Meg, er, was also involved.
It seems that wasn't enough for him, and now he's back trying to abduct more locals.
Why attack the jail, though?
We have a fairly large collection of inmates here, and we're mostly trained to keep them from escaping, not fend off a full-scale pirate assault.
Still, it's risky, and not nearly as subtle as his previous attempts.
My guess is his boss didn't take too kindly to his earlier failure, and now he's desperate.
He could fill his hold with prisoners from here, for whatever dark purpose he has.
Right then, so, how can I help out?
There's a bunch of stuff you can help us out with.
First and most obvious, you can take out the Skulls' landing parties.
My guards are doing what they can to keep them outside of the jail, but they need support from more experienced fighters.
Jed's ship is pounding the prison. Do what you can to repair the old lighthouse tower - if that thing falls it'll collapse the whole prison.
We also have a cannon up on the roof. If you have any experience in making things explode at a distance, you might want to muck in with that.
And of course, that cannon needs feeding with ammunition.
There are some portable furnaces and a mixing table on the jail roof, so if you can smith us some cannonballs or mix black powder, that'd be a big help.

conversations.section: At the Grand Exchange

pages.x: Hello, [sir/madam]. My name is Miles. Would you like to learn about bank notes?

pages.i: Would you like to learn about bank notes?

pages.x: Very good, [sir/madam].
Bank notes are pieces of paper that represent an item that can be bought or sold.
You can withdraw many items from your own bank in note form, so long as that item can be traded and does not normally stack.
To do so, click in the bank note toggle button and then withdraw your items as normal.
Conversely, you can move any bank notes from your inventory back into your bank. The simple act of doing so will store the actual item in your bank.
Okay, so bank notes are just representations of objects?
Indeed! Now, these 'noted' versions of items cannot be used as could the item itself be - they are, after all, just pieces of paper.
So what are bank notes good for, then?
Mostly for moving items around in bulk.
You see, with some items, you are only able to carry as many as will fit in your inventory - for example, you can typically only carry twenty-eight logs, fish or pieces of ore at a time.
But bank notes stack, so you are able to carry hundreds, thousands or even millions of the same item at once, and all taking up just one space in your inventory.

Bank notes can be traded with other adventurers or sold on the Grand Exchange; moved back and forth between your inventory and bank as you see fit, or even just dropped if you're cleaning your bank of junk.
Even some monsters are known to drop certain items in bank note form.
Anything else I should know?
Just one more point - because noted items hold the same value as the items they represent, you will find that you can trade them for certain goods and services.
For example, farming patch gardeners will accept crop-tending payments in the form of bank notes, and you can use noted ore to load the smelter in the Artisan's Workshop in Falador.
You can even cast the Low and High-Level Alchemy spells on bank notes and you'll create the same amount of coins as you'd have got from casting the spell on the item itself!
Wow, they sound pretty useful. Thanks for the info!
You are most welcome, [sir/madam]. Good day to you.
Very good, [sir/madam].

conversations.section: Before the destruction of Duel Arena

pages.x: Welcome to the Duel Arena.

o: How do I challenge someone to a duel?
What kind of options are there?
This place looks really old. Where did it come from?

pages.x: The Duel Arena has four arenas and a boxing ring where you can fight other players in a controlled environment. Duels are available to free players and members.
We have our own dedicated hospital where we guarantee to put you back together, even if you lose.
In between the arenas are walkways where you can watch the fights and challenge other players.
When you go to the arena, you'll go up an access ramp to the walkways that overlook the duels. From the walkways you can watch the fighting and challenge other players.
You'll know you're in the right place as you'll have a 'Challenge' option when you right-click a player. There are two types of duels.
There are 'Friendly' duels, in which you can duel against someone without staking anything, and there are 'Staked' duels, in which you can stake up to 50M coins.
You and your opponent can offer coins as a stake. If you win, you receive what your opponent staked, but, if you lose, your opponent will get whatever coins you staked.
You can choose to use rules to spice things up a bit. For instance, if you both agree to use the 'No Magic' rule, neither player can use Magic to attack.
The fight will be restricted to Ranged and melee only. The rules are fairly self-evident, with lots of different combinations for you to try out!
The archaeologists excavating the area east of Varrock have been working on this site as well. From these cliffs they uncovered this huge building.
The experts think it may date back to the Second Age!
Now that the archaeologists have moved out, a group of warriors, headed by myself, bought the land and converted it into the Duel Arena.
The best fighters from around the world come here to fight!

o: How do I challenge someone to a duel?
What kind of options are there?

pages.x: Ho, ho, ho!

o: How do I challenge someone to a duel?
What kind of options are there?

Are you singing your own songs...?
Do you have a song you could share with me?

pages.x: My sisters and I came out here to sing and practice our beautiful voices, we strive to become famous seasingers.
As quaint as the island we call our home is, not much ever happens there. Music needs inspiration, new impressions, a fresh breeze!
This place here is exciting, all kinds of creatures emerge from the depths and I adore watching the people going about their busy lives.
Are you singing your own songs or just reciting those of your people?
I take great pride in writing my own songs. Of course, there's classics everyone adores, but it's important to leave your own mark on the world.
Do you have a song you could share with me?
I'm still working on the lyrics, but I'd love to hear what you think!
That's is. What do you think?

o: What do you think about the siren's song?
I liked it. I find it very inspirational!
A bit cheesy, if you ask me.
I kind of spaced out halfway through.

pages.x: I liked it. I find it very inspirational!
Ah, a true appreciator of my song and storytelling, you flatter me! I will need to improve it, but I thank you kindly for being so encouraging.
A bit cheesy, if you ask me.
Well, it is a song for sailors and fishing folk after all. Their lives are hard enough, sometimes they just need something uplifting!
Sorry, I kind of spaced out halfway through.
What an awful habit. Sometimes I feel like people don't really listen to me. I wonder why they go through the effort of talking to me in the first place...
I thought maybe you'd have some reward for me?
*sigh* Sometimes our experiences are the real reward, rather than what waits at the end. I hope you'll come to understand that one day.

conversations.section: Standard dialogue

pages.x: Greetings Player. Welcome you are in the test of combat.

o: Where do the machines come from?

pages.x: What do I do here?
A spare suit of plate armour need you will. Full helm, plate leggings and platebody yes? Placing it in the centre of the magical machines you will be doing. KA-POOF!
The armour, it attacks most furiously as if alive! Kill it you must, yes.
So I use a full set of plate armour on the centre plate of the machines and it will animate it? Then I have to kill my own armour... how bizarre!
Yes. It is as you are saying. For this earn tokens you will. Also gain experience in combat you will. Trained long and hard here have I.
You're not from around here are you...?
It is as you say.
So will I lose my armour?
Lose armour you will if damaged too much it becomes. Rare this is, but still possible. If kill you the armour does, also lose armour you will.
So, occasionally I might lose a bit because it's being bashed about and I'll obviously lose it if I die... that it?
It is as you say.
Where do the machines come from?
Make them I did, with magics.
Magic, in the Warrior's Guild?
A skilled warrior also am I. Harrallak mistakes does not make. Potential in my invention he sees and opportunity grasps.
I see, so you made the magical machines and Harrallak saw how they could be used in the guild to train warrior's combat... interesting.
Harrallak certainly is an intelligent guy.
It is as you say.
Bye!
Health be with you travelling.

conversations.section: Talk to

pages.x: Good day to you, [sir/madam].

o: Sir Kay said you'd reward me.
Can you enchant Excalibur for me, please?
pages.i: What would you like to say?

pages.x: Indeed, I hear that you have earned his trust. You shall be rewarded handsomely!
What does that do then?
The enhanced Excalibur is wielded in your left hand, not your right, and its blade is far more powerful.
Thanks!
Can you enchant Excalibur for me, please?
Who are you?
I am the Lady of the Lake.
I seek the sword Excalibur.
I recall you have already proven yourself to be worthy of wielding it. I shall return it to you if you can prove yourself to still be worthy.
And how can I do that?
Why, by proving yourself to be above material goods.
... And how can I do that?
500 coins ought to do it.

pages.i: What would you like to say?

pages.x: Okay, here you go.
Thanks for the cash! I'm saving up for a new dress.

pages.i: Which version of Excalibur would you like back?

pages.x: 500 coins? No thanks!
Your materialistic attitude saddens me.
Good day.

conversations.section: Subsequent conversations

pages.x: Hello, Player!
Ahh tasks. Yes, yes, we can talk about tasks!

o: Would you like trinks to assign you a task?

pages.x: Oh, ok. Please come and see me again if you change your mind!
The Airut attack the village regularly, so we spend much of our time rebuilding or finding places to hide for when they come.
Over to the east you may find wood, tents and maybe even my friends unfortunate to have been killed washing up on shore.
What happened?
We had a village further up the coast. We thought we were safe and hidden, but in the night they found us.
Who found you?
The Airut! They came in the night, we were not prepared for it. I can still feel the heat of the flames and the screams of my friends.
The attack was led by the one they call Durzag, everywhere he goes there is a trail of death and destruction.
Are you okay?
Player I don't ever want you to feel the fear we Goebie's feel when we hear Durzag's name or roar.
It's okay. If I find this Durzag, I'll try and put a stop to him.
Oh thank you, I'm sure we Goebies couldn't thank you enough for helping to deal with him... There is maybe one more thing you could do for me though.
What's that? I'm always happy to help.
When fleeing from the attack on Cotoch I lost a trinket that means a lot to me, if you ever happen to find it please return it to me.
Sure!
My name is Trinks! I'm the taskmaster, you can talk to me daily for various tasks around the villages.

conversations.section: Standard dialogue

pages.x: Welcome to the TzHaar library, [Race]-[Caste]-Player. Can TzHaar-Mej-Lor, Lord of TzHaar Library, help you?
A TzHaar library, eh? I didn't know the TzHaar had libraries. Or knew how to read for that matter.
TzHaar have a very good language,[Race]-[Caste]-Player. We always have known how to carve and read but we have not always had library.
It was idea we got when JalYt started to visit TzHaar city. You seem very lost and very misplaced in our culture.
Yes, you crowd the Fight Pit which is good entertainment to watch, but you know nothing.
So to make city easier for JalYt to understand, we set up library and got books for you. But you do not seem to want to learn. Almost only TzHaar visit library now.
The few JalYt who do come here always ask about ashes and never about books. You seem to be obsessed with ashes.
How come the bookcases in the back are full of ashes?
Yes, TzHaar call them ashes. We did not bring them here for TzHaar. They are for JalYt who visit the city, so you can read and learn about TzHaar.
How are you supposed to read ashes?
They are JalYt books, you should know. I am TzHaar, we read on stone.
Alright... well, Im off now. Bye.
Are you not [Title]-[Caste]?
Well, yes, I suppose I am...
Then you [Title]-[Caste]!
No, thanks.

conversations.section: Talk to / Only on the first time

pages.x: Greetings, Player.
So you're a wise old man, huh?
Less of the 'old' man, if you please!
But yes, I suppose you could say that. I prefer to think of myself as a sage.
So what's a sage doing here?
I've spent most of my life studying this world in which we live.
I've strode through the depths of the deadliest dungeons, roamed the murky jungles of Karamja, meditated on the glories of Saradomin on Entrana,
and read dusty tomes in the Library of Varrock.
Now I'm not as young as I used to be, I'm settling here where it's peaceful.
It's a pity about that vampyre that keeps attacking the village. At least Saradomin protects me.
That's quite an exciting life you've had.
Exciting? Yes, I suppose so.
Now I'm here, perhaps I could offer you the benefit of my experience and wisdom?
Thanks! So how can you help me?
Well, I imagine you've gathered up quite a lot of stuff on your travels. Things you used for quests a long time ago that you don't need now.
If you like, I can look through your bank and see if there's anything you can chuck away.
Alternatively, you can bring items here and show them to me. If I see that it's something you don't need, I'll let you know. I might even be willing to buy it.
So you'll help me clear junk out of my bank?
Yes, that's right. Or I'd be happy to chat with you about the wonders of this world!

o: Could I have some free stuff, please?
I'd just like to ask you something.
Is there anything I can do for you?
Could you check my things for junk, please?
I want to talk about Archaeology collections.
pages.i: What would you like to say?

pages.x: Could I have some free stuff, please?
Deary deary me...

conversations.section: Talk to

pages.x: Hello, fellow runecrafter. How can I help you?
What are you researching?
Well, the Runecrafting wizards have got themselves into a bit of a state over a thesis published by a student.
We're also researching a new branch of Runecrafting at the moment: weapon imbuing.
What did this paper say?
Well, in short, it states that one day the altars like this one could run out of runic energy!
That's terrible! How will humans perform magic if we cannot make runes?
Well, it is still only a theory. Hardly any of the Runecrafting Guild wizards believe it to be true.
Still, we have not proved Wizard Finix's theories to be incorrect yet, and - if they're true - this is very worrying.
Wizards have been dispatched to all the known altars to investigate.
So, what can we do if Wizard Finix's theories are true?
Well, there is a new method being explored, which was detailed in Wizard Finix's thesis.
He is the best person to explain it to you; he is currently in the Wizards' Tower, if you want to speak to him.
What is weapon imbuing?
Well, if you bring an inert magic weapon to an altar, you can use rune essence to imbue the weapon instead of binding runes.
This process saturates the weapon with runic energy and thus increases its power. This way, even regular wood can be made into menacing magical armaments!
In theory, that is. During our studies, we only ever managed to imbue eternal magic wood, perhaps due to the strong inherent magical properties that it possesses.
Our fellow wizards aren't proficient enough to properly imbue the wood either. None were able to get more than trace amounts of runic energy to settle in it.
Why don't you try it for yourself sometime? Just fletch some eternal magic wood into a staff, wand or orb and bring it to an altar with some essence.
If you're more skilled than us, you might even confirm our theories and actually produce some usable weapons!

conversations.section: NovtumberFest / When talked to / First time

pages.x: Greetings friend! It is I, Wizard Deedit!
Hey, you're that wizard from the Valentines Event right?
That is correct!
Still branching out?
Absolutely, as fascinating as invention was I now have a particular interest in summoning.
What are you doing?
Why, I am currently researching wolpertingers, fascinating creatures they are!
What is a wolpertinger?
That's the beauty of it! Is it a rabbit? Is it a wolf? Is it something else? That's what I aim to find out!
Now let me tell you, there are 2 different types of wolpertinger.
Light wolpertingers and dark wolpertingers.
If you zap a light wolpertinger with a light zap it will be sent safely back to the spirit plane!
Same as if you zap a dark wolpertinger with a dark zap it will also be sent safely back to the spirit plane!

o: This would give you Summoning XP.

pages.x: However, if you get these the wrong way round the poor wolpertingers will be slain on the spot!

o: This would give you Slayer XP.

pages.x: Would you like to help with my research?

o: This activity gives Summoning and Slayer XP. Are you sure you want to continue?

pages.x: Well that's disappointing.

conversations.section: Conversations / Player Owned Head

pages.x: Have you considered visiting THE ABYSS?

o: I visit the abyss all the time.
Could I get an abyssal whip?

pages.x: I visit the abyss all the time.
I bet you just rush through it though. Everyone in there is in such a rush. No one stops to appreciate the beauty of THE ABYSS.

o: I have to run through quickly or I'll die.
The abyss looks pretty ugly to me.

pages.x: I have to run through quickly or I'll die.
Death is a small thing compared to the beauty of THE ABYSS.
The abyss looks pretty ugly to me.
Poor deluded fool. There is no hope for you at all.
It's too scary for me.
But does not the fear contribute to your appreciation of THE ABYSS?

o: I suppose fear does heighten the senses.

pages.x: No, it's just scary.
Poor human. You must not judge THE ABYSS by the standards of this world. You must learn to embrace your fear as part of the experience of THE ABYSS.
I suppose fear does heighten the senses.
Then you should enhance them further by raising the stakes. Next time you go to THE ABYSS you should take all your most valuable items with you.
Could I get an abyssal whip?
You must take all of your gold and most valued items, and take them to THE ABYSS without weapons or armour.
And then will I get an abyssal whip?
You'll get an ABYSSAL WHIPPING.
That pun was abyssmal.

conversations.section: Fort Forinthry / Talk to / Building the Grove / After speaking to Oak about completing the eastern border wall

pages.x: Hello, how are the new fortifications looking?
They're looking great, good job with getting those plans together so quickly.
Thanks, adapting one of the existing wall plans wasn't too difficult.
Now that the area is secure, plan is to use it to provide the fort with its own supply of lumber.
Its own supply of lumber... ?
That's right, with the land to the-
Like a lumber yard... ?
Oh no, this won't be a ya-
If only we knew someone who owned a lumber yard.
Ha, I know how it might seem bu-
A lumber yard just down the road even, which could provide all the lumber the fort requires.
Okay Bill, I know how it might look.
It's not actually a lumber yard we're building though.
Oh... it's not?
No, not at all, this is about providing a space to grow trees.
Oh, I see. Sorry about that then, it seems I may have got slightly carried away there.
Not a problem Bill, always good to find some humour where we can.
How can I help then, your grace.
We're going to need plans for a small cabin. Nothing too grand, just a comfortable space for our grove tender Oak to reside.
Certainly I'll get some plans drawn up now. We should be able to start construction when ever you're ready.
Thanks, Bill.

Alright.

pages.x: Hi Bob, How's tricks?
Hi Bob, How's tricks?
Tricks? Dogs are for tricks! Cats are for admiring and fussing over.
OK then, how about a joke instead?
Woof woof. Yip yip!
Excuse me?
Ah don't mind me. I am learning a second language!
No, you don't understand. I wanted to hear a joke.
Sigh... OK. Did you hear about the cat who drank 10 bowls of milk? He set a new lap record.
Did he? Wow. What about this joke then?
Are you trying to be funny?
No, that's your job isn't it?
Grrrowl. OK, last try. What do you call a cat that lives in an igloo?.... An Eskimew!
An Eskimew?... That's not funny. I waited all this time for that? Sheesh.
You know, sometimes I wonder why I still bother with this place. It's just not the same since the humans arrived.
Speak to me, Bob! Give me some wise words of advice!
Speak to me, Bob! Give me some wise words of advice!
Advice you want eh? Well, I could just enlighten you with a snippet of my vast knowledge.
That would be fantastic! I heard you were very very wise indeed.
Well, I think I will let you decide that.
OK, bamboozle me with your intelligence!

pages.x: Ahoy, Cap'n!
Avast ye scurvy swabs!
Huh?

o: Cap'n Izzy No-Beard: Don't mind me parrot, he's Cracked Jenny's Tea Cup!
What do I do in the arena?
I'd like to use the Agility Arena, please.
Is it true you sell Skillcapes of Agility?
I've noticed there are a couple of versions of each skillcape.

Buried treasure!

o: Cap'n Izzy No-Beard: It made me list, I were that excited!

Danger! Danger!

Tag when green light means tickets! Tag when red light means green light!

conversations.section: Standard dialogue

pages.x: Hello there.
Quiet! You must not break my concentration!

o: I need your help with something...

pages.x: Why not?

Well, if my concentration is broken while keeping this gate open, then, if we are lucky, everyone within a one mile radius will either have their heads explode, or will be consumed internally by the creatures of the Abyss.
Erm... And if we are unlucky?
If we are unlucky, then the entire universe will begin to fold in upon itself, and all reality as we know it will be annihilated in a single stroke. So leave me alone!
What are you doing here?
Do you mean what am I doing here in Abyssal space, or are you asking me what I consider my ultimate role to be in this voyage that we call life?
Um... the first one.
By remaining here and holding this portal open, I am providing a permanent link between normal space and this strange dimension that we call Abyssal space.
As long as this spell remains in effect, we have the capability to teleport into abyssal space at will. Now leave me be! I can afford no distraction in my task!
Ok, sorry.
I am attempting to subdue the elemental mechanisms of the universe to my will. Inane chatter from random idiots is not helping me achieve this!
Sorry to disturb you, I just needed your help with something quickly.
What? Oh... Very well. What did you want?

conversations.section: Before The Dig Site / West

pages.x: Hello.
'Ello. What can I do for you?
What do you do here?
Me? I'm a workman. I get paid to shift dirt, essentially. It's not a very good job, but it pays the bills.
Oh, okay, thanks.
I'm not sure.
Well, let me know when you are. I can't be standing around yakkin' all day, I got work to do!
Can I dig around here?
You can only use a site you have the appropriate exam level for.

o: I am already skilled in digging.

pages.x: Appropriate exam level?
Yea, only people who have passed level 1 certificate can dig in a level 1 site, and so on and so forth.
Ah, yes. I understand.
I am already skilled in digging.
Well, that's nice for you, but regulations say you can't dig around here without a certificate.
Oh, right.
The examiner at Exam Centre can help you.
Thanks, I'll talk to her.

conversations.section: Talk-to / After All Fired Up / Having also completed Troll Romance and My Arm's Big Adventure

pages.x: Oh, hello. What you want?

o: Could you look after this beacon for me?
Can you tell me about other beacons?
Is it possible to get information about beacons that are further away?
I'm done talking to you, now!

pages.x: Could you look after this beacon for me?
Can you tell me about other beacons?
Here you go. Have look at my map.
Is it possible to get information about beacons that are further away?
Hmm, me have sharp eyes, can see very far. Can tell you about all lit beacons in both directions from here. But, little flappy macaw can see much further still.
Flappy macaw?
If you brings Egg a little flappy macaw, I tell you anything you want to know about ALL de beacons!
Macaw can fly high into air and see long distance. They smart enough to report about things very much far away.
How's it going?
Oh, it going great! Nice, rocky mountain. Nice, scenic dirt. Best of all, it a nice, quiet day - so far, no danger in sight, though me not stop looking.
So, what exactly are you doing up here, all by yourself.
Oh, me keeping very close watch on horizon - it very important job, keeping watch for king.
Don't you ever get lonely?
Oh, not at all. There lots of rocks and sticks to talk to - dey make very good company.
You talk to rocks and sticks?
Yeah, dey very good listeners.
Well, I can't argue with that.
I'm done talking to you, now!
Goodbye den, little human.

conversations.section: In Draynor Village

pages.x: Can I help you at all?

o: Talk about Rag and Bone Man.
Can you tell me about Draynor Village?

pages.x: Yes, what are you selling?
Oh, you've come back.
Please, I haven't got any more vinegar. Give me some time, I beg you.
I wasn't after vinegar today.
Oh, wonderful.
I will have some in soon if 'he' needs it.
In the meantime, can I interest you in anything else?
No.
Well, I'll put something special to one side for you.
Thanks.
Yes, indeed. The finest wines in Misthalin.
Care to take a look at my wares?
The village is quite old, but the market is a rather recent addition. We were doing quite good business up until recently.
What happened?
Mysterious attacks began happening to villagers. Some say it's a vampyre, but I'm not convinced.
Well done killing that vampyre. Business has certainly improved since the attacks have stopped.
Happy to help.

conversations.section: Before Death Plateau

pages.x: Hello!
Well hello there! My, you're a cheerful one! How can I help you?

o: Aren't you afraid of the trolls up here?

pages.x: I'm Freda, welcome to my humble home!
My husband, Sabbot, and I came here to start a trading post. You know, selling dwarven arms to the Guard.
Then the trolls came and took over the plateau before we could get established, so I came to live here.
What about your husband?
That stubborn old mule won't leave the cave we were in! He'd rather die than let the trolls win.
I send him soup and letters now and then, and those nice men in town make sure he's okay.
Is there anything else you want?
Not at all. There used to be a few around here, but I soon dealt with them.
How? Aren't trolls really fierce in combat?
Yes, but I'm fiercer!
I'll have you know I've not been a trader all my life. I do know which end of an axe will do the most damage to a troll.
Besides, some of those nice young men from town give me a hand if the trolls come in numbers. But after the last time the trolls seem to have got the hint.
It's astonishing what waving an axe at groin height will do to break the will of even the biggest troll!
So why don't you live with your husband then?
Well, I can take on the occasional wandering troll, but a whole horde of them is something else entirely.
This place may not be that safe, but at least it's not the middle of a warzone.
Anything else I can help you with?
Oh? Well you take care on your way back.

conversations.section: In New Varrock / After Mummy Returns

pages.x: Thank you for returning Fluffs home - she told me everything!
First it was Fluffs, my beloved feline friend. She'd been purring by my side for almost a decade.
There was nobody here to help, so I sent my eldest sons, Wilough and Shilop, out to search for her.
That was the day the demon came...my poor boys. When the red terror burst up through the floor of the square, they were the first to be taken.
After the...the funeral, I was very upset. I shouldn't have gone into the city, not with the demon still about, but I was so lonely.
I only left the house for a short while. I made sure that my children Philop and Kanel were well fed, and the door was securely locked.
I'd barely stepped foot in the square when the dead marched on Varrock. The city guard sealed the gates to try to keep them out.
They wouldn't let me go back for my little Philop and Kanel. By the time the gates fell and the battle was over, it was already too late.
My home was a smoking ruin, and my boys were nowhere to be found.
After the necromancer took over, I moved into this building, since I had nowhere else to stay. I adopted one of the stray dogs, trying to fill the emptiness in my soul.
I've loved him and petted him, but he's changed, bless him. He tries to bite me, and only eats raw meat.
And now my pet fish, my poor little Dimies, has gone missing too! It's heartbreaking...
Oh but I don't want to bother you with the troubles of a silly old spinster and her tragic past. Fluffs is home now, and that's cheered me right up.
Oh, it's just like old times! We'll be together for decades to come!
Though she does say the strangest things sometimes - devouring souls and such, but...
She brought home her kittens too! They've been living stray in Varrock and I never knew. They're all upstairs.
Someone did take my fish - my poor little sardine - Dimies. Another tragic loss...
It's just as well, though. The cats would have eaten him by now anyway.
And one of the kittens gave me this strange book about cats. It's very interesting...
Come back soon!

That's bein' on account a' the fact I was raised by imps, innit. Luvverly chaps, imps. Right geezers.
Anyways, if ya gimme a 'and, [lad/lass], I can return a favour.
I come across this wild root on me wanderin', so I reckoned I'd stick about and get you geezers wif long legs to help nurture it.
The wee thing's growin' fast, but ya'd speed up the process if ya gave it some encouragement.
What's that thing growing nearby?
That? That's...thats a...it's a rare...uh...innit.
You don't know what it is do you?
No, not rightly...
But all a' Mother Gielinor's creations is worth looking after. Giz us a hand and encourage the wee thing, won't ya? It's growin' fast!
How do I nurture it?
That's easy, just interact with it, like ya would any Farming crop. That'll 'elp it to grow big and strong. Ya might even get yaself some Farming experience.
How long does it take to nurture it?
Why should I help?
There's 'uge rewards tendin' nature, 'elping weak things become strong. Ya might learn about Farming by helping this wee sapling grow into a tree.
Goodbye.
See ya'!

conversations.section: Man (worried)

pages.x: Hello.
Quickly - Tell me, is it still there?
Is what still where?
The THING, the THING! It was just outside my house! Has it gone away yet? Or is it still lurking out there, waiting for me to go outside?
I didn't see any THING out there, just a couple of guards. What did it look like?
Ohhh, it was HORRIBLE! It was an enormous THING, with TEETH and EYES and... and... and THINGS!
Um... would you care to be more specific?
I can't. I only saw it in the dark.
You only saw this THING in the dark?
I was sleeping peacefully one night, when suddenly I woke up and saw it through the window. It was LOOKING at me! I haven't dared go out since then.
It's had me trapped in here for days! I've packed my
bags so I can escape, but the THING's still out there waiting for me to come out! If I have to stay in here much longer I'll go mad! MAD!! MAD!!
There's no THING outside. Just come out and get some fresh air before you go funny in the head.
You want me to go outside?
I think you might just have dreamed about the THING.
You want me to believe that it's not real?
Please come outside!
No! No! I know what you are! You're in league with the THING! It keeps sending people in here to trick me into going outside! They keep stealing from me too! GO AWAY!
I'm not trying to trick you!
Get thee gone, trickster!
Sheesh...

conversations.section: In the Dorgeshuun mines / Talking to him

pages.x: Hello, friend?

o: Can I sell you some ore?
Why do the Dorgeshuun live underground?
Can you show me the way out of the mines?

pages.x: Can I sell you some ore?
Certainly. I will buy any iron or silver ore you mine. Speak to me again when you have some.
Why do the Dorgeshuun live underground?
Our ancient legends say that goblins were created by an evil god in order to fight in a huge way.
This god sent the Dorgeshuun tribe to fight a battle where all would die.
But our ancestors escaped by hiding in a deep hole in the ground where our god could not find us. Eventually an earthquake sealed the hole and they were forever safe.

o: The war is now, so you can return to the surface.
What was the name of your god?

pages.x: The war is over now, so you can return to the surface.
Even if the gods are no longer at war, I find it hard to believe that a tribe of peaceful goblins would be safe above.
I have heard of humans coming down into the caves to slaughter our people!
But even if we could return, we would not want to. We are adapted to living underground, and we have built a home for ourselves that we do not want to leave.
What was the name of your god?
Our ancestors did not speak his name, thinking that to do so would attract his attention. His name has been unspoken for so long that it is now entirely forgotten.
That is for the best. We have survived perfectly well without the gods, and we do not want a return to the old ways.
What happened to your arm?
I lost it in a mining accident a few years ago. This area is very unstable.
That's why we put markers on the wall showing the safest path.
Can you show me the way out of the mine?
Certainly. Come back soon!

conversations.section: Standard dialogue after Darkness of Hallowvale

pages.x: Hello again!
Hmph!

o: Safalaan said I could get more papyrus from you.
I'm lost. Can you help me?
Do you know about the Myreque?

pages.x: Safalaan said I could get more papyrus from you.
Hmph, hmm. I suppose so. Here you go.
What do you do here?
Hmph! Why? What do I know? I'm just an old man; what would anyone want with an old man?
I'm lost... Can you help me?
Hmph! Who says I'm not lost, eh? Ever think of that, did you?
In a rush to find out all the answers, not thinking for a second that someone else might be just as lost, if not more lost, than you!
And what do you care about them, huh?
Do you know about the Myreque?
Hmph! Why should I know about the Myreque, eh? What use have they ever been to me, huh? I ask you!
Can you help me?
Hmph! What makes you think that I can help you, eh? Do I look like a fountain of knowledge, eh? Do I?
Well, you've helped me before! You said something about symbols? To find the Myreque.
Hmph! Yes of course, that's how to get to them. Follow the symbols.
Which symbols?
The symbol of the Myreque - the silver sickle!
Oh, and where would that be then?
Around and about; it should be an aid.

How's it going?
Not bad actually, this is my second 'internship' for my brother Pete.
He's started to listen to some of my ideas!
Check out the new addition to the post office.
I've installed a delivery and collection ssytem where you can exchange your stamps for items that were previously obtainable in those parcels of ours.
That's just one of the awesome ideas that's made it into the postal service we've got going on here.

Would a few coins jog your memory?

Anything I can help with?
Well, if you could find some bone hurting juice, I may have an idea...
MWAHAHAHAHAHAHA

conversations.section: On Lunar Isle

pages.x: Hello there.
Welcome to the clothes store. How might I help you?

o: Do you have any use for suqah teeth or hides?
It's a very interesting island you have here.

pages.x: Do you have any use for suqah teeth or hides?
Most certainly! The hides are great for making clothes and the teeth are particularly useful for broaches, necklaces and the like.
I'll trade you any you can find for pure essence if you like.
It's a very interesting island you have here.
Why thank you. It's been our haven for a great many generations.
Everything seems to have a magical feel to it.
Of course. We integrate magic into all areas of our lives. It is a part of everyone, so why deny it?
It's best to make the most of this innate gift we have all been given.
What sort of things do you use your magic for?
Take a look around. We use it in our day to day lives, from making a cup of tea, to travelling around the island.
You see our ancestors were the ones that found the first rune essence and put it to use! The various factions were
eventually created, with people having different ideas on how the essence should be used (or not in some cases!)
What has kept you so secluded on this island?
It may be a bit beyond you, but although magic comes from within, we are all very strongly linked to the moon and the effects it has on us cannot be denied!
It can't?
Of course not. This very island has a great link to our moon, which helps us understand ourselves - especially our dreams, which is the path to understanding magic.
I think I will just have to take your word on that.
I'm good thanks, bye.

conversations.section: Wizard Vief

pages.x: Ahh, you'll help me, won't you?
Yes, I will help.
Excellent. Here are your wands. wait here and Wizard Elriss will open the portal when there are enough people to start. now, have I told you what to do yet?
Yes, you told me what to do.
Excellent.
Wizard Elriss told me what to do.
Well, that's something, but I should make sure you have the details right. Remember, you need to get the yellow orbs into the altar. got that? the yellow ones.
keep the green ones away.
Green good, yellow bad. Got it.
Weren't you paying attention? Yellow orbs are good, green orbs are bad! Move the yellow orbs next to the altar and the green ones away.
Acantha might have told you that the green ones are good, but she has her calculations the wrong way round. Don't let her fool you!
Wizard Acantha told me what to do.
You listened to her? You Idiot! 'Wizard' Acantha is old and senile. she made an elementary mistake in her calculations and got the green and yellow orbs mixed up.
Remember, it's the yellow orbs that are the good ones. Get them into the altars, keep the green ones away. got that?
How can you be sure your right?
I... but... isn't it obvious?
You just need to take Wizard Hellam's discoveries about the elemental rune energy signature and then extrapolate to include all kinds of runes.
then, if you apply the lefebvre transformation to them... I assume you know the lefebvre equations?
Well, I (Vief cuts you off)
Of course you do, I shouldn't have asked. anyway, if you do that, you'll easily see the signature of an external manifestation of runecrafting energy.
Then you will need to apply Wizard Bennay's theory of light...

conversations.section: Talk to

pages.x: I See. You?
Er, do you? With that weird hat on?
No. I am See - that's my name. Who are you?
Player.
I see.
You said that already.
You are here to ask me questions.
Am I? Are you asking me that or telling me?
Yes.
Er, okay.

o: Can you tell me about Birman?
Am I asking, though, or just leaving?

pages.x: Isn't that a contradiction - moon, dawn?
It is a metaphor.
Ancient cyclopean beliefs tell of the two creators - the Eyes in the Sky. Those being Hanalan - the sun - and Birman - the moon
When our path led us away from Bandos, we took back our old traditions. We are no longer naive enough to believe them being divine creators.
Rather, we recognise the good and bad that both the sun and moon can bring, and that both are necessary for our way of life.
As one of the eldest cyclopes, I hold the mantle of moon priestess, and represent the issues faced by those that live on moon-side.
And I contemplate the teachings of Birman within the Moon Tower.
When he brings the night, he brings sweetness to the world with berries and coconuts, and sometimes a tiny umbrella.
How does that work?
Hoo, boy. Well, if you don't already know, then I'm not the person to have 'the talk' with you.

pages.x: Hello. I have some fine silk from Al Kharid to sell to you.
Ah, I may be interested in that. What sort of price were you looking at per piece of silk?
20 coins.
Okay, suits me.
80 coins.
80 coins? That's a bit steep! How about 40 coins?
Okay, 40 sounds good.
50, and that's my final price.
Done.
No, that is not enough.
120 coins.
You'll never get that much for it. I'll be generous and give you 50 for it.

o: I'll give it to you for 60.

pages.x: Okay, I guess 50 will do.
I'll give it to you for 60.
You drive a hard bargain but I guess that will have to do.
No, that is not enough.
200 coins.
Don't be ridiculous! That is far too much. You insult me with that price.

B-b-but you're a pile of bones.
You're on the slim side yourself, pal. Don't be judging. It's not my fault.

The screaming little girl, like I was saying. You don't listen much, do ya?
Which little girl?
What was her name again? Carla, Caroline...
Cora?
Yeah, that's it - she did this to me.
Who are you...er, were you? Were you a Skulls pirate?
Yeah. The name's Pete, mate. Used to live in this here fort, now I'm just trapped in it.
From what I've seen of your gang, that would sound like justice to some people.
You sound just like her. 'This is justice', she says. I had no idea who she was at first. You see a lot of faces in the kidnapping game, don't remember any of 'em.
She knew us, though. Said we'd taken her when she was young, killed her folks, sold her to Goshima.
Then she did this to us and left.
What did she do to you?
It's too traumatic to talk about, mate. Ask one of the others.
I'm just going to leave you to it...

I could tell about the other beacons as well, if I have help from macaw.
A macaw?
Yes. Macaws can fly high into air and see long distance. They also very smart creature.
Can fly into air and then report back about whole beacon network.
How's it going?
Awful! Why you ask such stupid questions?

It hard to be friendly when feet hurt.

conversations.section: After the Player-owned-Ports tutorial

pages.x: Hello there!

o: So what work do you actually do here?
How did the port end up in disrepair?
Work to do, must be going.

pages.x: Ah - well. Let's not skirt around the wreck here, partner. I'm an old man. I'm not young or fit like your good self.
No, I'd only get in the way if I was out there trying to manage this place with you.
To be honest, I'm not sure if I ever was that capable. Even in the glory days I reckon I was just in the right place at the right time.
The old port just seemed to run herself.
These days I reckon it's best if I remain a silent partner.
I'll keep an eye of Duncan, here, and make sure he doesn't cause any mischief. That's almost a full-time job on its own.
You think I frittered my money away, right? Spent all my dosh on good livin' and bad choices?
Well, I can't claim to be the most savvy businessman, but believe it or not, it wasn't all my fault.
This port always traded with the east, ever since I founded it. We didn't send ships out to the east, the merchants travelled here.
And the things they brought here. I made a fortune. Richest man for miles.
And then suddenly they just stopped coming. This must have been twenty years back. So I did some investigating, sent out ships of my own. Only a few made it back.
What happened?
Well, they came back with stories of huge sea monsters; hydras, huge flying turtles, whales the size of islands that ate only men's skulls.
The beasts had started targeting ships, as if they were instructed.
Turns out it was a seasinger called Quin. Seasingers have the power to control the oceans - and those that in it - through song.
But they need to be close. Now, somehow Quin had found a way to control the monsters all at once from afar.
She held the east to ransom. She wanted them to worship her like a goddess, of course those Easterners don't believe in gods so they weren't going for it.
With no one coming from the east, my port just... fell apart. What could I do?
Of course, of course.

conversations.section: During The Mighty Fall

pages.x: Helloooo! I'm Yelps!
Who are you?
I'm Yelps, the richest and smartest goblin that ever lived!
It comes in handy, because I'm also the smallest goblin that ever lived.
I'm an entrepreneur! A self-made man!
Really? What do you do?
I used to run this game, see? Lucky people would punch me in the face to win prizes!
They...punched you in the face to win prizes?
That's right!
But how... Never mind.
What do you do?
Well, the game I used to run all sort of fell through.
It turned out the treasure I was givin' away actually belonged to some human princess or something, so I had to give most of it up.
She's still runnin' the game but...
*shudder*
There's no punchin'. Not even a bit!
There are... treasure chests!
I've been trying to reintegrate into goblin society, but it's not going so well.
Why are you here?
The high priest told me to get my best gear on and guard the camp! Here I am!
I'm done here.

conversations.section: Dialogue after fully cleansing the Nexus / After fully cleansing the Nexus:

pages.x: Thank you again, Player. I was worried this day would not come, but you have stopped the corruption.
There is some residual energy in the sack. Allow me to release it back to you.
I shall be forever grateful for your aid in releasing this land.
The effects of the purification can already be seen. I believe that the memory of Augrum is honoured by the work completed here.
Is there any other help that I can give you?

o: How can I train my spiritual skills now?

pages.x: Traditionally, ceremonial burial is used to honour the dead. To do this, you need to bury the bones of those that have been killed.
As I understand it, the more powerful that the creature was when it was alive, the greater the experience you receive from burying the bones.
If you are devoted to training your spiritual abilities, you can create a gilded altar in your home to boost this process.
I have also heard of something called the Ectofuntus, which grants increased experience from bones, but I do not know what this is.
All I do know is that it is located near to Port Phasmatys, far to the north-east.
Is there any other help that I can give you?
Augrum was my mentor. He gave his life creating those relics as a means to release the land from its inevitable decay.
He was a very brave and kind-hearted man, and I am grateful for your help in realising his intent.
Is there any other help that I can give you?
I believe that it will, through the hard work that you have done here. I will not allow that evil to come back.
Is there any other help that I can give you?
I feel close to Augrum here, and I want to ensure that everyone knows what he did, and what he sacrificed in order to free this land from that corruption.
I also wish to spread the word about all of the people who joined the fight and stood against the horror, using their faith and inner strength to save the land.
Is there any other help that I can give you?
Your aid will always be remembered.

conversations.section: Before Desert Treasure / If the player can start Desert Treasure

pages.x: Hello there.
Howdy stranger. What brings you out to these parts?
Nothing much - What are you doing here? It doesn't seem like there's much to do out here in the desert!
Well, that's where you'd be wrong. I work for the Archaeological Society of Varrock, and have been excavating around here recently.
Was there something you specifically wanted?
Who are you, anyway?
You don't recognize me??? I am the world famous Asgarnia Smith, Archaeologist extraordinaire!
I am the one who discovered the long forgotten Temple of Ikov! The one who unearthed the strange trap filled arena in Brimhaven!
I'm the leading archaeological expert of our time! I was voted archaeologist of the year four years running by the Varrock Herald!
Are you REALLY sure you've never heard of me?
No, I really haven't.
Well then, I'm confused. Why did you come over and speak to me if you don't know who I am? What do you want?
Do you have any quests? Call it a hunch, but you look like the type of man who might...
Well, its funny you should say that.
I'm not sure if I would really call it a quest as such, but I found this ancient stone tablet in one of my excavations, and it would really help me out if you could go and take it
back to the digsite for me to get it examined.
It's very old, and I don't recognize any of the inscriptions on it.
Nothing really. I'm just wandering around for no good reason.
Uh-huh. Well, if you'll excuse me, I have a lot more work to do before I can bed down for the night.

conversations.section: In Rellekka / Before The Fremennik Trials

pages.x: Greetings outerlander!

o: Why will no-one talk to me?}}

pages.x: What is this place?
This place? Why, this is Rellekka! Homeland of all Fremennik! I do not recognise your face outerlander; Where do you come from?
That's not important...
Hmmm... I will not press the issue then outerlander. How may my tribe and I help you?

o: Why will no-one talk to me?
Why do you call me outerlander?}}
I seek an army to destroy Asgarnia!

pages.x: Why do you call me outerlander?
Do not take it as an insult, outerlander. For us, this town is the center of all. Anyone not born here, or that we do not know and trust is an outerlander.
So it basically means stranger?
Aye, but that is an outerlander word. We do not judge someones ways by their name. It simply means one from the outerlands, or one not from Rellekka.
I know our customs are foreign to you; perhaps you would like me to explain something else?
I seek an army to destroy Asgarnia!
We will have no part in the squabbles of outerlander tribes. Their magics are strange and deadly to us, as we learnt long ago.
If this is all that you came here for, then you have had a wasted journey. If you are looking for something else, then speak now for my patience dwindles.
Who are the Fremennik?
It is the name we call ourselves. Outerlanders tend to call us 'Barbarian', but they do not understand our ways...

o: Why will no-one talk to me?
Why do you call me outerlander?

pages.x: Nice hat!
Do not mock me outerlander; this helm has saved my life more times than I care to recall right now.

conversations.section: On Aminishi

pages.x: Hello there, did you come to help me with the temple?
Who are you?
Have we met before? My name is Bryll Thoksdottir, I'm a Fremennik explorer.
Why are you here?
The Fremennik are following the example of our greatest hero, to seek out the seeds of evil and destroy them and to aid the oppressed.
While the main bulk of our band is trying their hardest to uproot the horrors of Daemonheim I'm travelling to investigate the rumours of places that might require a heroic intervention.
It's so hot here. I'm not used to this.
What help do you need?
Since the Wushanko Isles became accessible again after the number of sea monsters dropped I've poked my nose around the Arc.
The Acolytes of Seiryu stationed in the temple on the top of the hill worship a guardian beast of the sea and work to better themselves through a strict training regimen.
While that's admirable there's a rumour that those at the top have been acting strangely and no-one's been able to see the guardian beast for a long time.
Perhaps you and a couple of friends could investigate for me?
What's in it for me?
You've already aided us in exploring Daemonheim and by helping me you can work on training your Dungeoneering skill here too. I'll award you tokens for your efforts.
You can trade your tokens back at Daemonheim with my brother, Marmaros. He's got a lot of stock that can benefit you on your adventures.
If you're not confident in your combat abilities and still want to investigate you could probably find a way to traverse the temple safely, but I can't reward you for that.
Goodbye.
Farewell. I'm not going anywhere, should you want to want to come back later to help.

conversations.section: As crew of Sarim's Revenge, after Head of the Family / Whale's Maw

pages.x: I spy, with my big eye, something beginning with 'T'.
Aren't you a bit old for that game?
No? Okay, fine. Is it turtles?
Nope.
Ha! It's turtle shells then!
Naw.
Tarpons?
Nope.
Oh, are you being clever? Is it turquoise?
Ooh, good guess!
Oh, was that it, then?
No.
Well, what is it?
It's 'trouble'. Trouble, with a capital T.
Trouble, how so?
Thalassus.
Wait, what, where?
Out on the horizon. Something's got it riled up.
It's more often spotted off the coast of Thalassia, for which it's named. Seeing it this far west can't be a good sign.
I'll be sure to keep an eye out for it when we're at sea.

conversations.section: After Plague City, before Plague's End / While not wearing full Mourner gear

pages.x: Hello.
Oh, hello.
You seem upset... What's wrong?
My son fell ill with the plague...
That's awful, I'm sorry.
It would be easier to cope with if I could have spent his last few days with him.
Why didn't you?
Those mourners came and whisked him away. He didn't even seem that ill, I thought it was a common cold...
But the mourners said that he was infected and had to be taken away. Two days later the mourners returned and told me he had died.
Again, I'm sorry. Life can be harsh.

o: Where did the plague come from?
Have there been many victims of the plague?
I hope things get easier for you.

pages.x: Where did the plague come from?
It's down to King Tyras. He and his men brought the plague here from the darklands, and then left us to suffer. One day he'll pay for what he's done!
Have there been many victims of the plague?
You could say that... I've heard reports that half of West Ardougne is infected! Many have lost friends and family...
It sounds an awful way to live.
People are very depressed and scared. I've never met anyone fully infected though. I suppose we should be grateful to the mourners for that.
I hope things get easier for you.
Me too...

conversations.section: Talk to / Inactive / Without crocspeak

pages.x: Grrrrmmmmmmm....
What is it, boy?
GGGRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRR
You're hungry?
ARGHHHHHHHH
You want pets?
RRRGGGGHHH
A belly rub?
GGGRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRR
No? A massage?
ARGRRRRRHHHHHHHH
Not good enough, huh?
RRRGGGGHHH
A deep-tissue massage, perhaps?
AAAARRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRR
No? Hot stones instead?
HHRHRRRRRRRRRRRGHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH
This isn't going anywhere.

o: Chito grumbles in what seems to be agreement.

pages.x: Maybe if I was wearing my crocspeak amulet...

conversations.section: Foreshadowing / After the queue is empty / Talking to Closure for the first time

pages.x: Ah, welcome to the end of your story! I am Closure; I will be the one writing your final chapter. Now, let me quickly check your file... Oh, dear...
No, surely that can't be right... This is bad...very bad, indeed... No, this won't do at all.
Um...
Death has left a note here in your file. It appears you aren't supposed to be here for at least another month.
A month? I only have one month left to live?
At least... I said at least... Anyway, that is not the issue. You are Player, correct? Let me make a quick edit to your biography and...
Done!
I am most definitely Player. I am NOT Relomia. Hey, I said it right that time! You've fixed it, thank you, Closure!
Excellent. Though, we're not quite out of the woods just yet. Your little clerical error is resolved, but Relomia is still out there using your stolen identity.
Is that a big deal?
I'm afraid so. While Death has restored your ability to be reborn after dying, that is just the mechanical side of this issue.
However, the longer Relomia is out there writing your story, the more long-term damage she could cause. Her story is now intertwined with your story.
I will be able to write her contributions in your name as footnotes, but only for a short time. It is entirely possible she could end up replacing your role in history.
She could, effectively, write you out of existence. Stories are powerful things.
I will defer to your expertise. How can I stop it?
Death has sent me along a contract that will return your identity to you. You will, however, need to get her to sign it. Willingly.
She'll never sign anything I hand her. She thinks I'm dead or gone; soon as she sees me, she'll know something's up.
Hmm... I could tweak the glamour spell she placed on that ghastly hat. So long as you wore that while talking to her, she would not see you as you.

o: Closure hands you the unsigned contract.

pages.x: Excellent. Now, get Relomia to sign that, then return it to me here. To get back here, use the hourglass north of the Draynor Village lodestone.

conversations.section: With the orb

pages.x: Y..y..you hold the stone of...
There is no time.
You can never let it be freed.
It's not time yet.
Who are you? What can't be freed? No time for what?
So many questions.
So little time.
Liberate us.
Free us.
Don't let it out.
PROMISE US.
I don't kno..
PROMISE US.
I promise.
It's coming for us.
We can no longer endure this pain.
We are not ready.

conversations.section: Regular dialogue

pages.x: Go away, I'm very busy.
Sorry to disturb you.
What are you busy doing?
I'm cooking pizzas for the people in this camp.
Not that these louts appreciate my gourmet cooking!

o: So what is a gourmet chef doing cooking for bandits?
Can I have some pizza too?
Okay, I'll leave you to it.

pages.x: So what is a gourmet chef doing cooking for bandits?
Well, I'm an outlaw. I was accused of giving the king food poisoning! The thought of it! I think he just drank too much wine that night.
I had to flee the kingdom of Misthalin. The bandits give me refuge here as long as I cook for them.
Can I have some pizza too?
Well, this pizza is really meant to be for the bandits. I guess I could sell you some pizza bases though.

o: Oh, if I have to pay I don't want any.

pages.x: Yes, okay.
Oh, if I have to pay I don't want any.
Okay, I'll leave you to it.
Have you anything to sell?
Well, I guess I can sell you some half-made pizzas.

conversations.section: Tricking the Godless

pages.x: Who are you?
I am just a lowly follower of Sliske, here to play a game.
Goodbye.
What do you want?
I want your help. I have a little game to play.
I have managed to convince a Godless agent that I am a reliable source.
I can deceive them and make them launch one attack on [enemy faction].
But I need 20 followers of [player faction] to ask me before 20 followers of [enemy faction] do.
Do you want me to persuade the Godless to attack [enemy faction]?
Yes, attack my enemy.
Thank you. I hope you enjoy my game as much as I do.
No, I'm not playing your game.
Life is a game. Only by dying can you not play.
What do you get out of this?
For me? Why, I just want to help you continue your beautiful war.
So, do you want me to persuade the Godless to attack your enemy?
What do you want? If already voted
I have heard your voice, and will bear in mind your actions.
What do you want? If 20 players from one faction have voted
I have all the help I need. Perhaps next time we can... play.

conversations.section: On a Fresh Start World / Talk to

pages.x: Hello there, Player. Can I help you with anything?

o: Can I view the Fresh Start Worlds Reward Shop?
Can I view the event information?

pages.x: We are on a Fresh Start World. Here everything is new again, starting from nothing. The world is there for the taking by adventurers such as yourself!
On these worlds adventurers will experience the game at an accelerated rate, as these worlds will only exist for a couple of months.
They will also gain access to other tools to help them reach new heights as they progress! Like this armour I am wearing, which will improve as I gain experience.
As well as other things, such as increased harvests from resources, speedy access to auras, increased life and prayer points and many more.
There will also be new hiscores and world firsts to race for during the first eight weeks, with prizes for those who get there first!
Those who reach a world first or a top spot in the hiscores at the end of these eight weeks will receive a fresh title and an exclusive tradeable halo.
That sounds great!
There's more!
It is also possible to unlock inverted skillcapes for any skill whose cape they unlock whilst on these Fresh Start Worlds.

o: They reveal a different yet familiar skillcape.

pages.x: Interesting. Is there anything else?

There are some additional fresh-looking rewards there for adventurers to earn, including halo-wearing skilling pets and a halo which everyone on Fresh Start Worlds can earn to commemorate their achievements...
...or sell for their efforts.
So there is plenty for you to be getting on with. But you shouldn't dawdle - the worlds won't be around forever!
Sounds like it! I should probably get to it!
Can I help you with anything else?
Nothing, I was just leaving.

conversations.section: Talk-to

pages.x: Hello young [man/woman]! Come to visit old Grandpa Jack? I can tell ye stories for sure. I used to be the best fisherman these parts have seen!

o: Sorry, I don't have time now.
Can I buy one of your fishing rods?
I've forgotten how to fish, can you remind me?

pages.x: Tell me a story then.
Well, when I were a young man we used to take fishing trips over to Catherby; The fishing over there - now that was something!
Anyway, we decided to do a bit of fishing with our nets, I wasn't having the best of days turning up nothing but old boots and bits of seaweed.
Then my net suddenly got really heavy!
I pulled it up...
To my amazement I'd caught this little chest thing!
Even more amazing was when I opened it it contained a diamond the size of a radish! That's the best catch I've ever had!
Sorry, I don't have time now.
Sigh...
Young people - always in such a rush.
Can I buy one of your fishing rods?
I've forgotten how to fish, can you remind me?
Of course! Let me see now...You'll need a rod and bait. You can fish with a net too, but not in the competition.
Ok... I think I can get those at Catherby.
Then simply find yourself a fishing spot, either in the competition near here, or wherever you can - I recommend net fishing in Catherby.
Net or Lure the fish in the fishing spot by clicking on it and then be patient...
It's that simple?
Yep! Go get em tiger.

conversations.section: Combining / Fourth hand of glory

pages.x: And so I was telling [him/her] to just figure it out for themselves because I was watching my soaps and...
Hold on, Meg, I've got a call on the other line...
Hello? Who's calling? Aris speaking.
Oh, um, sorry to interrupt. I can call back if you'd prefer? It's Player.
No need. How can I help, Player?
Actually, just contacting you I figured it out.
