conversations.section: Encounters / Conversation 1

pages.x: Erm, hello? Can you understand me?
I certainly can. I am wearing this amulet I got in Sophanem!
Ah so you've met some of the local felines. Wise and confusing, those Sphinges.
Wow!! You know the plural of Sphinx!! What else do you know?
All sorts of stuff! I pick up no end of comments on my travels. Want to hear one?
I certainly do. Share your wisdom, Bob!

conversations.section: Location-specific dialogue / Taverley

pages.x: Hi Bob. What are you doing here?
Ah, another person who thinks I want to talk to them just because they can understand me.
Aww, come on!
OK, you asked what I'm doing here.
I'm here to study the druids.
They're boring, but they know how to treat animals, and they don't go around bothering you just because they've got a silly gadget that lets them understand what you say!

conversations.section: Wisdom / Wisdom 2

pages.x: Sorry I am too busy marking my territory.
Your territory? This place is ruled by Grand Highmage Gower and his minions.
I think not. They are my minions. And I let them think he's in charge. I’m the real power behind the throne.
I knew it!!
Yeah, it keeps them happy that way, but don't tell anyone!
Hee hee. OK Bob.

conversations.section: In the Dwarven Mine / Historical dialogue prior to 14 April 2025

pages.x: Hello tall person.
Hello short person.
Why are you called Boot?
I'm called Boot, because when I was very young, I used to sleep, in a large boot.
Yeah, great, I didn't want your life story.

conversations.section: On Lunar Isle

pages.x: Hi! What are you up to?
Watering the pretty flowers, you want to help?
I don't have time to water flowers, I have people to save!
Pft, you should take time to enjoy the simple things.
I'm not a simple person.
So it seems.

conversations.section: Standard dialogue after Rum Deal / Brewer #3 (tricorn hat)

pages.x: Hello there!
Well you proved that you're probably not a zombie. So what are you then? A ghoul? A vampyre?
I'm not any form of undead!
Oh...oh god I'm sorry, I didn't realise it was natural...
What?
Nothing...

conversations.section: Standard dialogue after Rum Deal / Brewer #5 (long hair hairstyle with split beard)

pages.x: Hello there!
Hello yourself!
How's things?
Fine...
Excellent! Since I get the feeling I don't want to know why you said that so oddly I'll just go over here!
I think that would be for the best!

conversations.section: In Brimstail's cave / Before The Grand Tree

pages.x: Hello adventurer, what can I do for you?

o: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?

pages.x: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?
Okay. Hold onto your hat!
Nothing for now, thanks!
Ok. Just remember that a friend of a wizard is a friend of mine!

conversations.section: First conversation

pages.x: Oh, woe is me! Lamentations! Woe!
Are you alright, brother?
I don't think so. I don't think I'll ever be alright again...
What's wrong?
I've been sent a vision. A most terrible vision indeed! Demons are beginning to push through into our world in unprecedented number.
I have seen fields of bones...rivers of blood and brimstone!

conversations.section: Using Ruined essence on him

pages.x: Oh dear. I have read about this day, but I thought that it would not come within my lifetime.

o: Brother Celerity produces a tiny box, which he seems hesitant to open.

pages.x: You must take this. I must take that. It is how it was written.
Please. You must.
Well, if I must.

o: Brother Celerity hands you the box, from which you withdraw an odd doll.

conversations.section: Talk-to / Before All Fired Up

pages.x: Hello there! What might you be up to?
Oh, I'm looking after this beacon for King Roald.
How is that working out for you?
Oh, very well, thank you. The time away from the Monastery has given me opportunity to meditate and reflect on my path in life.
That sounds very spiritually fulfilling.
It is, indeed. It's very satisfying to be able to look after one's spiritual needs while serving one's kingdom as well.

conversations.section: After Ritual of the Mahjarrat

pages.x: Did you see what happened to Edgeville?
Did I see what happened? I have had the holiday from hell.
What do you mean?
Of course I saw what happened! You can't undo the past... but I certainly cannot repeat it. I expect anti-dragon nets to be fitted by the end of the week!
If I had to rate the holiday out of five, I'd struggle to give it more than a three; as such I'm going to the Varrock Herald about this!
Here, take a signed copy of my diary, it'll be worth millions when I'm done with them!

conversations.section: Before Family Crest

pages.x: Who are you? What are you after?

o: Nothing, I will be on my way.
I see you are a chef, will you cook me anything?

pages.x: Nothing, I will be on my way.
I see you are a chef... Could you cook me something?
I would, but I am very busy. I am trying to increase my reknown as one of the worlds' leading chefs by preparing a special and unique fish salad.

conversations.section: Standard dialogue / Before the destruction of Duel Arena

pages.x: Hello old chap.
What are you doing here? Shouldn't you be looking after your glider?
I'm pretty much retired these days old fellow. My test piloting days are over. I'm just relaxing here and enjoying the primal clash between man and man.
You're watching the duels then. Are you going to challenge someone yourself?
I do find the duels entertaining to watch, but I suspect that actually being involved would be a lot less fun for me. I'm a lover, not a fighter!
Errm, I suppose you are.

conversations.section: In Varrock / After River of Blood

pages.x: First you helped us defeat Zemouregal's zombie army, and now you've saved all of Misthalin from invasion by Morytanian bloodsuckers.
You're a veritable scourge of the undead.
Vampyres aren't undead. They're living creatures, originally from Vampyrium. It's a common misconception.
Regardless, you're welcome. Any news on where Zemouregal and Arrav went?
Nope, not yet.
There's still a whole bunch of zombies in Zemouregal's old Wilderness base, but we've not seen hide nor hair of the individuals we're truly interested in apprehending.

conversations.section: In Burthorpe

pages.x: Welcome to my shop, friend. Are you here to practice runecrafting?

o: Can you teleport me to the Essence Mine?
Tell me about the skills menu.

pages.x: When you cast a spell, you tap into the latent power of runes.
Naturally occuring runes are incredibly rare, but the recent rediscovered art of runecrafting allows us to create them ourselves.
By acquiring essence stones and infusing them at an elemental altar, you make it possible for mages to work their magic.

o: Achieve 99 in all your skills to earn the coveted Max Cape!

conversations.section: Talk-to

pages.x: Be careful going in there! You are unarmed, and there is much evilness lurking down there! The evilness seems to block off our contact with our gods,
so our prayers seem to have less effect down there. Oh, also, you won't be able to come back this way - This ladder only goes one way!
The only exit from the caves below is a portal which is guarded by greater demons!

o: I don't think I'm strong enough to enter then.
Well, that is a risk I will have to take.

pages.x: I don't think I'm strong enough to enter then.
Well, that is a risk I will have to take.

conversations.section: In Zanaris / Talking to Chaeldar

pages.x: 'Ello, and what are you after then?

o: Do you have anything for trade?

pages.x: Do you have anything for trade?
I have a wide selection of Slayer equipment; take a look!
Er...nothing...

conversations.section: In Prifddinas, after Plague's End

pages.x: Can I help you with something?

o: I want to toggle my active Daily Challenges.

pages.x: I am Heriau of Clan Cadarn, a direct descendant of Baxtorian, the king of old.
I'm the challenge mistress in charge of assigning challenges and handing out rewards. They're all here on my list...
A Daily Challenge is a job to complete: anything from forging swords to baking potatoes. We assign you three challenges per day.
To complete a Daily Challenge, you don't have to give me the items you gather or produce. Keep those for yourself, and use them or sell them!

conversations.section: In Menaphos

pages.x: Can I help you with something?

o: I want to toggle my active Daily Challenges.

pages.x: Rashida's the name - Akhomet's cousin. She's military. I'm civilian.
I'm the challenge mistress in charge of assigning challenges and handing out rewards. They're all here on my list...
A Daily Challenge is a job to complete: anything from forging swords to baking potatoes. We assign you three challenges per day.
To complete a Daily Challenge, you don't have to give me the items you gather or produce. Keep those for yourself, and use them or sell them!

conversations.section: In the Mage Arena / After praying at a statue, without the cape in backpack

pages.x: Hi.
Hello adventurer, have you made your choice?
I have.
Good, good, I hope you have chosen well. Have you been rewarded with a cape from your chosen god?
I'm afraid I don't have it with me.
Once you have your cape, come back to me, and I shall supply you with a mage staff ready for battle.

conversations.section: In the Mage Arena / Before praying at a statue

pages.x: Hello my friend, Kolodion sent me down.
Sssshhh... the gods are talking. I can hear their whispers.
Can you hear them adventurer, they're calling you.
Erm... ok!
Go chant at the statue of the god you most wish to represent in this world, you will be rewarded.
Once you are done, come back to me. I shall supply you with a mage staff ready for battle.

conversations.section: In Burthorpe

pages.x: Enter and be welcome in this place of prayer.

o: Tell me about the skills menu.

pages.x: Saradomin will answer your prayers if your heart is true. The faithful receive great bounty; their abilities in combat bolstered by their belief.
The most hallowed of powers is almost-complete immunity to a form of combat: melee, ranged or magic.
I wish that piety itself were enough, but you must also demonstrate it through works. Bury the bones of the dead to show your commitment.

o: Achieve 99 in all your skills to earn the coveted Max Cape!

conversations.section: Standard dialogue after The Firemaker's Curse / Without having completed The Temple at Senntisten, The World Wakes or Fate of the Gods / Below 91 Firemaking

pages.x: What do you plan to do now?
I will stay here and train, until I am worthy again.
Train in Firemaking?
Of course, fool.
Could you train me?
Perhaps. I see a spark of talent in you, but you need to progress your skills further before you are worthy of my time.

conversations.section: In the Desert Monkey Colony / While wearing a monkeyspeak amulet

pages.x: Chimp ice! Get your chimp ice!
Sure, I'll buy one.
How's business?
Booming, my friend. Booming! Buying the rights to these treats may be the best financial move we've ever made. Would you like to buy one?
I've got to go.

conversations.section: After Plague City, before Plague's End / While not wearing full Mourner gear / Civilian #1 (long hair with green pants)

pages.x: Hi there.
Good day to you, traveller.
What are you up to?
Chasing mice as usual! It's all I seem to do nowadays.
You must waste a lot of time?
Yes, but what can you do? It's not like there's many cats around here!

conversations.section: Foreshadowing / After the queue is empty / Talking to Closure for the first time / Post mini-quest dialogue

pages.x: Ah, Player. I have to say, I'm glad to have crossed paths with you. I've been looking into your life some more and it is fascinating.
The vast majority of my work is, to be frank, pretty mundane. It's a rare treat that I get to write a yarn as gripping as yours.
I wonder if you might be interested in collaborating with me on your biography while you're still, er, living it...
You are such a storied individual, I would love to pick your brain about where you've been, where you are and where you think you might be going.
Er...
No need to give me an answer right now. Just have a think about it, okay?

conversations.section: Standard dialogue

pages.x: Hello...human. Welcome...to my store
Oh...not much to tell.
I...am Coeden. I...sell seeds.
Crwys...are my friends.
Take a look...at my seeds...for sale. I also sell...saplings.

conversations.section: In the Burthorpe Troll Cave

pages.x: Hello, [sir/madam]. Can I help?

o: What are you doing in here?
Can you give me any combat advice?

pages.x: These caves are teeming with trolls, so I've been stationed here by the Imperial Guard to keep them contained.
I also buy and sell combat gear, so if there's anything you need just let me know.
The best advice I can give is to always have some food with you, for healing.
There are farming patches, fishing spots and hunting areas in Taverly, to the south, that you can use.

conversations.section: Talk-to / Before All Fired Up

pages.x: What you doing here? No one told Crate to expect visitors!
Huh? Wait, what's going on here?
Not authorised to tell. It too important.
Well, it looks like you're just standing around, daydreaming about rocks.
It much more important - and top secret! Crate too important troll to talk to likes of you.
Okay, fine. Catch you later.

conversations.section: Talking to Dalldav

pages.x: Can I help you at all?

o: Yes please. What are you selling?
Why do you sell this stuff?

pages.x: Why do you sell this stuff? The Crystal Bow is so much better.
We keep all these old toys to train our children with, but if people will part with coins for them, then they are theirs!
No thanks.

conversations.section: Talk to

pages.x: Hey there!
Urrm... hello!
What are you doing here?
I'm looking for Love Letters.
Love Letters?
Yes! The more I can find and destroy, the less love that's shared around. I can't stand this time of year!

conversations.section: Before the tools have been delivered

pages.x: Would you look at that?
Look at what?
Why this chest that I've found - buried right here in Falador all along. My research had led me here but I never expected to actually find it.
Why don't you get it out then?
It's stuck! I'm waiting on some tools to be delivered here so we can start extracting it from the ground - a young woman named Alice is funding the excavation.
The tools should arrive here in [number] day(s). Once they're here feel free to come back and help with the excavation.

conversations.section: During the lost sword of King Raddallin event / Initial dialogue

pages.x: Goodness me, can you believe it? After all this time it was buried right here in Falador and we never even knew.
What are you talking about?
You don't know? Praise be to Saradomin, we think we've discovered the lost sword of King Raddallin, the first King of Asgarnia!
I've been tracking this treasure for years but had never expected to find it so close to home.
We can't open the chest yet but we're asking for adventurers' help to recover and open it. So..are you ready to help us?
I'm sure they'll be a reward in it for you and plenty of skills to train while we uncover this treasure.

conversations.section: Upon death / Second or more death, but losing items for the first time

pages.x: Hello again..

o: Am I dead for real this time?

pages.x: I have more to tell you.
No, but I have more to tell you.
It's alright, I just have more to tell you.

conversations.section: Before Throne of Miscellania

pages.x: Good day, Sir. Can I help you with anything?
Can I use your anvil?
You may.
Nothing, thanks.

conversations.section: 2025 April Fools / After the player completes their mount training / After receiving the ring of riding

pages.x: Make sure to take good care of Rocky. He's a feisty little thing!

o: Where did you get all these 'mounts'?

pages.x: I want my money back!
You didn't pay me anything for the mount?
Where did you get all these 'mounts'?
Let's just say I borrowed a couple from some friends of mine.

conversations.section: 2025 April Fools / Before the player completes their mount training

pages.x: Howdy, partner!
Hello.
I assume you're here to get a mount?
Mounts? Finally!
Whoa there. Before you can buy a trusty steed, you'll have to complete training with Fabio over there.
Come back to me when you finish.

conversations.section: In Draynor Village / Claiming Ocean's Bounty rewards

pages.x: Howdy there, partner.
Hi, Diango.
Are you here to claim Ocean's Bounty rewards?
Okay.

conversations.section: South of Keldagrim / After Birthright of the Dwarves / If Veldaban is dead

pages.x: I wish I'd spent more time with Veldaban when he was alive, rather than being obsessed with this rock.
My only son, and I ignored him because he became a Black Guard rather than a miner.
Since you helped me mine the rock, I've had all the riches I could want...but all the gold in the world won't bring my son back.

o: Can you shoot me into the rock again?
Are you selling those boots of yours?
That's great, but I have to go.

pages.x: I'm sorry for your loss.
Thanks.

conversations.section: In Lumbridge / Case 2

pages.x: Hello there, can I help you?

o: Are there any quests I can do here?
Where can I get a haircut like yours?}}

pages.x: Yes, it does look like you need a hairdresser.
Oh thanks!
No problem. The hairdresser in Falador will probably be able to sort you out.
The Lumbridge general store sells useful maps if you don't know the way.

conversations.section: North of Falador / After Doric's Task VIII

pages.x: Hello traveller, what brings you to my humble smithy?

o: Do you have any more Smithing tasks for me?
I lost an item you gave me.
I wanted to use your anvils.
Do you have any advice for aspiring adventurers?

pages.x: Not at the moment, we have it all under control now. Thank you for all the assistance in helping us grow.
You wouldn't believe how well we're doing. It's all thanks to you giving me that one initial push. Was there anything else you wanted?
Was there anything else you wanted?
Go right ahead. Least I can do after the help you gave me.

conversations.section: North of Falador / Before What's Mine is Yours / First time talking to Doric

pages.x: It's over, it's over...
Are you okay? What's over?
My business, my life...everything! It's all in ruins.
Calm down and tell me what's happened.
Nurmof should have sent his pickaxe order through this week but I've heard nothing. He's been my most loyal customer for years, and he's not the only one to stop.
I'm ruined!

conversations.section: Talk-to / With a catspeak amulet / After All Fired Up but before A Tail of Two Cats

pages.x: Hi, there. I was wondering if you could help me.
That depends. Can you tell me any interesting stories? It's rather boring around here, you see.
Of course, I can tell you great stories! I'm an amazingly interesting adventurer, don't you know.
Pshaw! I'm not interested in your boring human stories - I'm interested in some good feline gossip.
Oh, uhh...
Oh, never mind; it was asking a lot. If you come across any juicy tidbits, do stop by for a chinwag.

conversations.section: At the Burthorpe Agility Course / Talk to

pages.x: Everyone needs to keep themselves in tip-top shape! All the time! Soldier? Artisan? I don't care! Let's work out!

o: Tell me about the skills menu.
I'll let you get on with your work-out.

pages.x: You get on that assault course and you RUN AROUND IT UNTIL YOUR LUNGS BURN! GO! GO! GO!
Have you ever heard the expression 'a healthy mind in a healthy body'? Well, I haven't! But that doesn't mean we shouldn't EXERCISE!
A well-exercised body can take shortcuts that those weak and strange people can't manage. Not to mention, you can run farther and you'll need less rest!

o: Achieve 99 in all your skills to earn the coveted Max Cape!

conversations.section: Using plain doll on him

pages.x: Does this belong to you? Someone found it in the woods.
Bracha!
No...
No... Please don't show me that.
I... I have to go.

conversations.section: In Lumbridge Castle / Historical dialogue

pages.x: Greetings. Welcome to my castle.

o: I seek a shield that will protect me from dragonbreath.
Have you any quests for me?
Can you give me a quick summary of what happened?
Can you show me what happened again?

pages.x: The situation in Lumbridge is catastrophic, but I believe it is possible to do something about it if we break it down into small, manageable chunks.
I have officially unlocked the emergency treasury and plan to use it to address individual problems that come to my attention.

conversations.section: Het's Oasis / Using gnome foods on him / Spicy crunchies or premade spicy crunchies

pages.x: My favourite!

o: Dundee takes the spicy crunchies from you.

pages.x: Wait, I didn't say you could have them!
Oh, sorry! Here, there's some left if you want it?

o: Dundee offers you a half-chewed crunchie. There's a bit of drool on it.

pages.x: You know what? Don't worry about it.

conversations.section: In Shilo Village, before While Guthix Sleeps / Talking to Duradel

pages.x: 'Ello, and what are you after then?

o: Do you have anything for trade?

pages.x: Do you have anything for trade?
I have a wide selection of Slayer equipment - take a look!
Er...nothing...

conversations.section: Standard dialogue

pages.x: Hello there. What's in the pot?
The stew for the servants' main meal.
Can I have some?
Well not unless you become a servant. There's a war on, you know, so food is scarce.
Good point. I should probably leave you to it.
Bye then.

conversations.section: Talk to

pages.x: *grumble* What do you want?
What services do you offer?
*grumble* It says on the board right there. You can rent a boat, or I can take you on a boat tour.

o: Take a boat out onto the lake.

pages.x: Actually, I don't think I want anything.
Fine.

conversations.section: Leaving the tutorial / Talking to Vicendithas

pages.x: It is done. Excellent.
When incubating the effigies, if the machine is active and in it's enhanced state, the effigies will duplicate due to the excessive power.
Incubating one uncharged effigy will generate two effigies.
If you run out of time but still have the materials required to make an effigy, you can still incubate them.
Due to reduced power, you will only receive one effigy per uncharged effigy incubated.
Now, quickly, add your uncharged effigy into the incubator. You can add more than one if you need to, but one should be sufficient for now.

conversations.section: Talk-to / After All Fired Up / Without having completed Troll Romance and My Arm's Big Adventure

pages.x: So, what exactly are you doing up here, all by yourself?
Der usual. Watch fire. Watch horizon. Watch fire some more.
Sounds absolutely thrilling. Look, not to change the subject, but is there any way you could help me out? I've got a couple of questions.
Hmm, not so sure. Maybe if you help trolls, me help you.
Oh but I'm a great friend of the trolls. Just ask anybo- I mean any troll.
Don't know. I think about it. Meanwhile, leave me alone and let me get back to watching fire.

conversations.section: In East Ardougne / After Mourning's End Part I, before speaking to Arianwyn in Lletya

pages.x: Hey ya Elena.
Hello Player, so have you found out what those Mourners are up to yet?
Sort of, they seem to be looking for an old temple buried deep under the mountain.
This temple is meant to give them access to great magical power, but I have no idea what that is yet.
Well let me know when you find out.
I will.

conversations.section: After Tree Gnome Village

pages.x: Hello Elkoy.
Yes please.
Ok then, follow me.
No thanks Elkoy.
Ok then, take care.

conversations.section: Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza / First-time dialogue

pages.x: Player!
How's it going?
It's wonderful!
The ringmaster seemed to want to push us away from the other acts; something about fiery carnage...
I'm just happy to be running the fire poi again! Let me show you how to do it!
Okay.

conversations.section: In New Varrock

pages.x: I see you looking at Ernie's urns! You steal 'em, Ernie steals your kidneys. Ernie promise!
You know nothing! Hehe, Ernie puts the 'urn' in 'Burn'.
Urns are magical pots. They fill up when you're skilling.
A cooking urn collects juicy, tasty scraps when cooking.
When it's full, add a rune and teleport it to Ernie. Tasty urn for Ernie! Yum-diddly-yum!

conversations.section: In the Mourner Headquarters / After Mourning's End Part II and before Plague's End

pages.x: Any news yet on our missing dig team?
No, I have looked everywhere, but I can see no sign of them.
This is not good news, did you find anything else down there?
Nothing other than the beasts you spoke of.
I must ask you to return to the search and remember if you see anything elven-made down there you must let me know. After all that is what we are here for.
I'll come to you as soon as I dig anything up.

conversations.section: Celebration of Fire

pages.x: Uh... Hello there.
What are you doing here?
Chad said that they needed some help running the celebration this year so I tagged along.
What's going on around you then?
Oh! We're summoning pretty fire spirits using special fire stones.
That sounds like a lot of fun.

conversations.section: In Lumbridge / Historical dialogue / During the Battle of Lumbridge and before the Lumbridge Rebuildathon

pages.x: My house! There I was, sat in the living room, having a nice cup of tea and minding my own business, and BANG! My house collapses around me!
I went to look - after all I am an explorer - and there, right outside my house, I found Saradomin and Zamorak fighting it out!
Seems that their battle had a rather unfortunate effect on my foundations. So, I went back inside and made another cup of tea.
I thought to myself that it'll take more than a world-destroying battle between two gigantic all-powerful gods to stop me!
So I'm not letting it get me down. I'm still a taskmaster and I have a job to do!
Glad to see the battle is over now. I'm not sure how Zamorak will recover from that defeat.

conversations.section: In the mines below Witchaven, after Kennith's Concerns

pages.x: Are you not going home, Ezekial?
Oh, I will soon; I'm just taking in the atmosphere...
The 'atmosphere'? This place has brought us nothing but trouble.
Absolutely, but that just increases my determination to rid the world of those sea slugs once and for all. Anger is an energy, Player.
I'm a bit worried about you, Ezekial. I think you ought to go home and relax.
Maybe you're right. I'll go soon, just give me a little more time.

conversations.section: Standard dialogue / Case 1

pages.x: What are you dwarves doing in this factory?
Working of course, can't you see that?
But working on what?
Refining the ore that is being brought into the factory, of course.
And what does that mean?
It means you should stop asking so many questions and get back to work!

conversations.section: Standard dialogue / Case 2

pages.x: Who owns this factory?
The Consortium does and that's all you need to know.
But what company? I thought there were all these different companies?
Oh yes, all the major companies own this plant. It's too vital to be in the hands of one company alone.
And what exactly are you doing here?
I tire of these questions. Let me get back to work!

conversations.section: Talking to the fairy or attempting to use the nearby fairy ring

pages.x: This fairy ring will take you out of Zanaris. It leads to the place known as Al Kharid in your realm. Once passed, you can not return this way.
Before leaving, make sure that you have fully sampled the delights of our marketplace.

o: I think I'll stay here a bit longer.

pages.x: I think I'll stay down here a bit longer.
As you wish.
Yes, I'm ready to leave.

conversations.section: After Plague's End

pages.x: Hello there. Have you heard the truth about your sheep?
Aye. Councillor Halgrive told me about the fake plague. My poor sheep suffered and died for a pack of liars...it's the innocent who pay the price for man's ambition.
To tell you the truth...
I'm glad you killed King Lathas. We were all sheep in his eyes. You brought justice to these lands.
I am glad you exiled King Lathas. Good riddance to him. Though I hear his cousin's not much better.

conversations.section: Talk to / After completing the Secrets of Amberfell quest

pages.x: We're allowed to talk again!
Sorry - I find it so hard not to chat with strangers. They're just so interesting!
Let me know if you find any goodies out in the woods. I'm always on the hunt for new resources!
Goodbye.
See you around!

conversations.section: Mining and smithing / Showing off your ores / Talking to the Mining instructor / First time

pages.x: Great work! The better the pickaxe you use, the faster you'll mine. Also, the better the pickaxe, the higher the [Mining/Mining] level you'll require to wield it.
So why do I want to mine ore?
You can use your [Smithing/Smithing] skill to smelt ore into metal bars at a [furnace/furnace].
Then at an [anvil/anvil], you smith the bars into melee weapons and armour worn by warriors.
You can smelt [tin/tin] and [copper/copper] together to make [bronze/bronze] equipment.
Simply deposit the ores into a furnace, forge, or anvil, then use the furnace to smelt them into a bar of metal.

conversations.section: Prayer / Talking to the Prayer instructor / First time

pages.x: Good day, brother. My name's Player.
Hello, Player. I'm Brother Brace. I'm here to tell you all about [Prayer/Prayer].
Are there rules for how I should behave?
Yes. In general, always try to be courteous to others - remember that adventurers like yourself are real people with real feelings.
If you go around being abusive or causing trouble, you could end up in trouble.
I'll keep that in mind.

conversations.section: Talk-to / Before All Fired Up

pages.x: Hi there. What are you doing here?
I'm afraid that I don't have much time to chat right now.
Really? You don't seem to be doing anything but standing around.
Well, that's where your eyes deceive you! I'm not only standing around, I'm also scanning the horizon.
It takes a lot of energy and concentration to remain prepared for emergencies.
I see.

conversations.section: Before Nature Spirit

pages.x: Hello there.
What... Oh, don't creep up on me like that... I thought you were a Ghast!
Can I go through the gate please?
Absolutely not! I've been given strict instructions not to let anyone through. It's just too dangerous. No one gets in without Drezels say so!
Where is Drezel?
Oh, he's in the temple, just go back over the bridge, down the ladder and along the hallway, you can't miss him.

conversations.section: After A Tail of Two Cats

pages.x: Hi Unferth. How's Bob?
I don't see him as much as I used to but he's fine.
Feeling OK?
Well my spleen is playing up again...
I must go, something came up!
Oh, OK.

conversations.section: In New Varrock

pages.x: Top of the morning. At least I think it's morning. Can I interest you in some crafting supplies?
I also have some gem stones for sale. Uncut, but don't ask me where I got them.

o: Can I see what you have?
Where did you get the gemstones?
Does New Varrock ever get sunny?

pages.x: I told you not to ask me that. Let's just say I've made some friends in questionably legal places.
Who needs daytime when it's always sunny in our hearts?
Haha! Hahahahaha! Who says zombies don't have a sense of humour?

conversations.section: After One Piercing Note

pages.x: Hello again, adventurer.

o: Is there anything I can help you with?

pages.x: How are you doing?
Is there anything I can help you with?
Thank you, adventurer, but no. You have done enough.
Goodbye.

conversations.section: In Keldagrim marketplace

pages.x: Welcome to my clothes stall, can I help you with anything?

o: Yes, what clothes do you have in stock?

pages.x: Yes, what clothes do you have in stock?
Not a lot, I’m afraid, most of what I produce goes to my sister. Her shop is in Keldagrim-West.
Well, show me what you do have then.
No, I’m just browsing.

conversations.section: During the 2018 Halloween event

pages.x: Goodness, is everything okay over there?
Oh yeah, just an evil power that I'm working with Death to stop causing harm to Gielinor.
You adventurers, you're so funny! I know what's really going on, this is one of those 'pranks' I've heard so much about, right?
Umm, what?
Don't play your silly games with me; it's pretty obvious really. Just look at all those over the top props. Let me give you some advice - play it more subtle next time.
Oh yeah. You got me! Ha...hahaha...HAHAHAHAHAHA!

conversations.section: I have more information about the Mahjarrat / Desert Treasure

pages.x: I inadvertently freed a being called Azzanadra from a pyramid to the west of here.
So, what was he like? Was he another conniving and evil follower of Zamorak?
Well, now you come to mention it, he wasn't a follower of Zamorak and he was actually rather helpful. He taught me a bunch of new spells.
I'm still not convinced he's entirely trustworthy, but he didn't seem all that bad either.
It's all very interesting. You know it does increasingly seem that not all these Mahjarrat are completely evil.
Not to the extent some people would have you believe, anyway. There does seem to be a bit of a mix of personality types, like with many other races.

conversations.section: I have more information about the Mahjarrat / The Temple at Senntisten

pages.x: Dr Nabanik, who you met at the Varrock Dig Site, was actually Azzanadra in disguise. I helped him restore a ruined Zarosian temple under the the site.
Varrock Dig Site... That's where the Zarosian city of Senntisten once stood.
When Zaros was banished long ago, Azzanadra used the temple to communicate with him. With the temple in ruins, the link was broken.
That explains why Azzanadra's Nabanik persona seemed to be obsessed with Varrock Dig Site. But you say the temple is now restored?
Yes, and with the temple restored, Azzanadra and Zaros can communicate once more.
How intriguing! I take it Zaros is still banished, but I wonder how long he will remain so.

conversations.section: I have more information about the Mahjarrat / While Guthix Sleeps

pages.x: Lucien has managed to get hold of another artefact. From what I can tell, it's quite a bit more powerful than the Staff of Armadyl - it's called 'The Stone of Jas'
The Stone of Jas? That sounds highly unlikely.
You've heard of it?
Yes, I've seen passing references to it in some old texts I've read. I doubt it's real though.
I can assure you it's very real. I touched it with my own hand before the Mahjarrat ran off with it.
Well, this is very frightening news. Who knows what havoc the Mahjarrat will be able to wreak. I shall have to ponder on this.

Thanks!

When I decide to start work again. Right now, I'm enjoying sitting on this bench.

pages.x: What a delightful gift! It reminds me of the wine we vinified in my homeland.
What a...peculiar odour. I wonder how it tastes.
I must admit, that is...unpleasant.
This blood was not given willingly. Whatever poor creature produced this held no love in its heart as it bled.
Apologies, my dear. I appreciate the thought, truly, but this is not to my taste.

pages.x: What are you doing?! Digging in this area is strictly prohibited!
Err...
Look! A new ancient civilization to exploit.

pages.x: Now, excavation is one of the two main aspects of archaeology. You'll find a number of excavation hotspots across the various dig sites.
Excavation hotspots have many names, but the first step is always to uncover
them, like that Senntisten soil over there.
Your main goal will be to slowly dig up an artefact from them, but while doing so you will obtain a number of other useful finds.
We'll discuss the value of these as we go.

conversations.section: Relics / Sacrificing the mortal cup / Harnessing power of the relic

pages.x: You managed to access the power that relic contained. I'm impressed Player!
Here I was thinking I was recruiting just another intern today. I wasn't expecting you to go one better than our very own Guildmaster!
I've only assumed the position of Acting Guildmaster, because I believe Tony can and will return to us.
That said, I feel you have the potential to climb up our ranks very quickly - you've a natural affinity with this stuff.
Speaking of which, come and meet me in the main campus building just west of here to claim your first qualification. We need to get you working at a dig site pronto!

Gudrik is as brave as he is strong. Ashdale owes both of you a debt of gratitude.

I don't have anything to reward you with except my collection of bleak, gothic poetry I wrote when I assumed we were all done for. Do you want it?
I may come for it later, you hang on to it for now.

conversations.section: Standard dialogue after Rum Deal / Brewer #8 (pirate bandanna)

pages.x: So...got any sleep yet?
My brain is no longer capable of sleep.
So...what are you going to do now?
I was gonna try and will myself dead.
Right...good luck with that.

conversations.section: Pay / If the bush is a poison ivy bush

pages.x: There is no need for me to look after that poison ivy.
Really?
Yes, poison ivy is pretty hardy stuff, and most animals will avoid eating it.
Hence, there is no reason to worry about it.
Great.

conversations.section: After The Great Brain Robbery / On Harmony Island

pages.x: How's your head feeling?
A lot better, thanks. Can I help you with anything?
Would you like me to take you back to Mos Le'Harmless?
Not at the moment, thanks.

conversations.section: After The Great Brain Robbery / On Mos Le'Harmless

pages.x: How's your head feeling?
A lot better, thanks. Can I help you with anything?
Would you like me to take you to Harmony?
Not at the moment, thanks.

pages.x: The Brown Engine can always rely on you, Player.
I will get my secretary to send this to the trade floor at once!

conversations.section: In Taverley

pages.x: I seek heroes to assist us in the siege of Daemonheim. Will you give us your aid?

o: What dungeoneering recommendations do you have for me?
Can you help me with the dungeoneering outfits?

pages.x: Far to the east lies a dungeon complex which is the source of a dark and strange power.
We are helping bands of heroes explore this complex to unearth and deal with this force.
Can you help me with the dungeoneering outfits?

conversations.section: Talk to

pages.x: So, ye wanna look like me do ya?
No? I never said that.
I 'erd you did.
No, you di-
Beauty!

conversations.section: In the Troll Stronghold / Before Eadgar's Ruse

pages.x: Er, hi.
Hmm? What human do in troll kitchen? Burntmeat tired of cooking goats. Human look tasty.
Oh, you don't want to eat me! I'm a tough, hardened adventurer, not tender or tasty at all!
Hmm. Burntmeat think you probably right. What human doing here?
Nothing. I was just leaving.

conversations.section: After Carnillean Rising

pages.x: 'Ello again, mate.

o: What happened to the old butler?
What do you know about the Carnilleans?
You don't talk like a butler.
pages.i: What would you like to say?

pages.x: The Carnilleans are one of Ardougne's richest families. They're snooty, but there's no harm in them.
They're bound to have a book on their history somewhere in the house, if you want to know more.
Oh, I save all the formal stuff for Sir Ceril and the family.

conversations.section: As crew of Sarim's Revenge, after Head of the Family / Waiko / After completing Jed Hunter

pages.x: I miss home. Being a ship captain was hard.
Where's home?
An island south of here called Cyclosis. Not many people know of it, because only us cyclopes know how to navigate its waters.
Would you show me how to get there?
Perhaps, one day. I must get over all of this Jed business first. I can not return home in shame.

conversations.section: Menaphos

pages.x: I don't like it here captain. I can feel...something beneath this city.
Something good or something bad?
Hmm, neither, I think. Just something 'other'.
You cyclopes are quite sensitive, aren't you?
What we may lack in depth perception, we have learned to compensate for by sharpening our other senses. Tread carefully, captain.

conversations.section: Talk to / After the Visions of Havenhythe quest at Wendlewick port

pages.x: Looking to head back to Port Sarim?
Yes, please.
The trip will cost you 30 coins.
Not right now, thanks.

conversations.section: After Contact!

pages.x: Hey there, how're you holding up?
Not too bad. Since the town reopened, the embalmer is importing a soothing balm from a merchant called Ali M. It's meant to take the itch away.
Does it work?
Not even remotely, but it does keep the flies away. Those plague locusts and frogs aren't too keen on it either. Would you listen to me; I'm rambling.
Let's talk business.

conversations.section: During the event

pages.x: Something rather interesting is happening...
These dunes have started to appear across Gielinor. I can't help but wonder if it's because of Reyna and her love for the beach.
This dune here appears to be the biggest and it's been here the longest. My assistant is travelling across Gielinor in search of any others.
How can I help?
I think you've got enough energy within you to help us for a while but once it's run out, you'll have to rest and wait until the next day before you'll be able to help again.

conversations.section: Standard dialogue / If the player has a Witchwood icon in their inventory

pages.x: Be ye some form of simpleton? Do ye not hear the howlin' of the Horrors?
Well, I can hear something now you mention it.
That be them, howlin', always howlin'!
If ye value yer limbs ye'll put that Icon round yer neck, and hope they don't come out into the light!
Err, all right, I'll get right on that.

conversations.section: After tier 21 of Journey to Iaia

pages.x: Thank you Player. George the Gurh should be back to his charming self shortly and we can take our leave.
As happy as I am to find pieces of our peoples' history with this world. It is a shame to realise how manipulated our kin were by the gods and their machinations.
But, this is our home now and we should do whatever we can to sustain it.
Perhaps Olun'dai does not just apply to life on Iaia, and we can help heal the troubles of this world too, yes?
A very nice sentiment Ceciro. I wish you the best of luck.

conversations.section: In the Mage Arena / After claiming the free staff

pages.x: Hello again.
Hello adventurer, are you looking for another staff?

o: What do you have to offer?

pages.x: No thanks.
Well let me know if you need one.

conversations.section: In the Mage Arena / After praying at a statue, with the cape in backpack

pages.x: Hi.
Hello adventurer, have you made your choice?
I have.
Good, good, I hope you have chosen well. I will now present you with a magic staff.
This, along with the cape awarded to you by your chosen god, are all the weapons and armour you will need here.

conversations.section: Standard dialogue / Without the little book o'piracy or having completed Rocking Out

pages.x: Hello!
Arr? Be ye wantin' te go on account with our gang o' fillibusters?
The powder monkey be takin' a caulk after gettin' rowdy on bumboo, so there be plenty of room for ye.
Riiiiight...
I'll just be over here if you need me.

conversations.section: Talk-to / During the Gielinor Egg Hunt

pages.x: Welcome to the zoo! Is there anything you need help with?
Hello there, I don't suppose you've seen a golden egg around here have you?
I have indeed, I actually have one of the eggs right here.
The friendly fellow that dropped it off said someone would come looking for it. Here you go.
Thanks, Charlie.

conversations.section: Foreshadowing / After the queue is empty / Talking to Closure for the first time / Reclaiming the players identity

pages.x: Well, that's the paperwork taken care of now, too. Congratulations, you are yourself once again.
Relomia did escape, though.
Never the matter. I have separated her antics into her own biography again. She didn't get up to anything overly nefarious.
You mean other than killing me?
Exactly. No harm done. No lasting harm, at least.

conversations.section: Talk-to / Normally / After completing the Lumbridge and Draynor tasks

pages.x: I know you've been very active around Lumbridge and Draynor. Perhaps I could reward you with some food?
Yes, please.
There you go.
No, thanks.

conversations.section: After Sheep Herder and before Plague's End / While wearing full Mourner gear

pages.x: Hello.
Hello, is there any news about how our sheep keep getting infected with the plague?
Not that I know of, sorry.
I'd sure like to know why we can't contain it. Please raise the issue next time you see the Head Mourner.
I'll keep it in mind.

conversations.section: Talking to Creakyknees

pages.x: Where did you get that lens?
From that strange metal thing up on the hill.
You should give that back!
Even if it's cracked?
Ah, well, I suppose it's of no use. But, still.

conversations.section: In Keldagrim Library

pages.x: Oh, that's nice, another human visitor to Keldagrim!
Indeed!
And what brings you to this city? Come to seek knowledge as well?
I think it's mostly fame and riches I'm after.
To each [his/her] own, I suppose.

pages.x: Would you like to buy or sell some scimitars?

No, thanks.
Do you have any Dragon Scimitars in stock?

What do you do here?
I bring goods in from outside. Need anything?
No, thanks.

pages.x: What do you want?

Of course I'm still here.
I'm not going near that crack in the wall again.
Rock falls and so on are fine, but sea monsters in caves - never!

pages.x: Hello there, can I help you?

Are there any quests I can do here?

pages.x: Are you asking for free stuff?

pages.x: Hello there.

What are you doing here?
I'm studying for the Earth Sciences exam.
Interesting... Perhaps I should study for it as well.

conversations.section: After Gunnar's Ground, at the Leptoc manor / After engraving the dragonstone necklace

pages.x: I have one last piece of jewellery to engrave.

pages.x: An onyx amulet!

pages.x: I have another piece of jewellery to engrave.

conversations.section: Talk to / During the 25th Anniversary celebrations task

pages.x: Greetings, adventurer.

Sorry, no, just doing a nostalgia tour, reminisicing about the old days.
Ah, well, then. If stories are your fare, you might want to find and talk to Skaldrun - he knows a saga or two about this place...
As long as it doesn't involve ferrets, count me in! But perhaps I'll do that later; I'm doing some tasks right now.

Yes please!
There you go.

o: What, on your ship! No thanks!

What exam is that?
It's the Earth Sciences exam.

Perhaps one day, but I'm looking for someone with better skills to be honest.

conversations.section: Leaving the tutorial / After collecting 20 of a material / With an effigy casing

pages.x: Good. I think that should be enough.

This is the framework around which we can construct an effigy, a powerful item which should give us useful benefits.
Go and build one now and then we can see about empowering it.
Then bring it to me.

conversations.section: Talking to the elder rune fanatic

pages.x: Wow, what is that you are wearing?
I'm wearing fully upgraded elder rune armour. You will be able to smith it yourself in the upcoming Mining and Smithing rework.
To smith it, first you'll need to mine some light and dark animica ore, which requires 90 Mining and an appropriate pickaxe.
Then with 90 Smithing, you'll be able to smelt the ores and a rune bar into elder rune bars, and smith elder rune armour and weapons.
Oh wow! Do you have more information about the rework?

conversations.section: In East Ardougne / After Biohazard and before Regicide

pages.x: Hello Elena.
Hey, how are you?
Good thanks, yourself?
Not bad, let me know when you hear from King Lathas again.
Will do.

pages.x: Hello, still looking for tracks?
The tracks of my brethren are harder to follow than you could imagine.
I guess so.
Bye.

conversations.section: Recruiting Elissa as guildmaster

pages.x: Hello, Elissa, I have a proposition for you.
Of course, Guildmaster, how might I help?
I've seen your work on golems and wondered if you have any interest in joining my research team...
Hmm, while that would be of interest, I still need to finish off the last of my husband's research on golems.
I still need to recover a restored golem instruction from somewhere. I hear some are to be found at the Stormguard Citadel.

conversations.section: "Custom-fit Trimmed Masterwork" option

pages.x: What does custom-fitting do?
It will become untradable.
It will degrade 50% slower so it'll last longer.
It will also never degrade while on a slayer or reaper task.
But the process is irreversable. Once custom fitted, your masterwork will always be custom fitted.

Plus a choice of [number] combat XP or [number] coins.

o: Can I have a different contract instead?
pages.i: What would you like to say?

Thanks!

pages.x: I'm sorry, I'm looking for the blast furnace?

Thanks.

conversations.section: After gathering an enriched memory

pages.x: I have made one further discovery. Would you like me to share it with you?
I have discovered you can use divine energy to change one item into another!
Just take the correct tier and amount of divine energy, along with a secondary ingredient, and you are able to produce a higher quality object. You should try it!

conversations.section: In Al Kharid / After Demon Slayer but before The Golem

pages.x: Are you Player?
Yes...
I've heard all about how you killed the demon Delrith!
My partner Badden and I are observing another group of wizards, and we think they're planning to summon another demon.
They haven't found a place to perform their ritual yet, but when they do, we might need your help!

conversations.section: Before Ratcatchers

pages.x: What was it I heard about some pits around here?
It is... It used to be my rat pits. You could bring your cats here to fight. It was going to be glorious! It was open for years. Not a single person visited!
How could so many be so foolish as to ignore such brilliance?
I guess brilliance is one word for it.

o: - Felkrash glares at you angrily, you walk away while you can. -

conversations.section: After completing Shilo Village

pages.x: Welcome to Fernahei's Fishing Shop Bwana! Would you like to see my items?

o: No, but thanks for the offer.

pages.x: Yes please!
No, but thanks for the offer.
That's fine and thanks for your interest.

conversations.section: Standard dialogue

pages.x: It is dangerous to go beyond this point human. Let me help you prepare yourself.

o: Can you fetch any loot I might've missed?
Show me my current raid lock.
Can you automatically reset my raid lockout?
Would you pay any Teci for these burial charms?

pages.x: That should be possible human.
Very well, human.

conversations.section: Relaxing

pages.x: I love it out here!
I came here to make money and catch big fish, but I stayed for the peace and the calm the ocean brings to my mind and the camaraderie amongst the people here.
Don't you ever get seasick on these platforms here?
Never! To me, it feels as if I'm cradled soothingly by the ocean, night and day.
Not sure my stomach agrees...

conversations.section: Standard dialogue (supposedly)

pages.x: You should speak with the ruler of this isle, King Gjuki Sorvott IV.
Is there anything else I can help you with?

o: Can I have a look at your stock please?

pages.x: Can I have a look at your stock please?
No, nothing just now thanks.

conversations.section: In Draynor Village / Historical dialogue

pages.x: Can I help you at all?

o: Talk about Rag and Bone Man.
Can you tell me about Draynor Village?

pages.x: The village is quite old, but the market is a rather recent addition. We were doing quite good business up until recently.
What happened?

conversations.section: After As a First Resort

pages.x: What you want, human?

o: So what do you have for sale, then?

pages.x: Never mind.
You a bit annoying, human; you know that?

conversations.section: Standard dialogue

pages.x: Hello; how can I help you?
You can't; I'm beyond help.

pages.x: Good day, [sir/madam].

Good day.

pages.x: Welcome to my home. It's rare for me to have guests! Would you like a cup of tea? I'll just put the kettle on.

o: Brother Galahad hangs a kettle over the fire.

pages.x: Do you get lonely out here on your own?
Sometimes I do, yes. Still not many people to share my solidarity, as the Saradomin I know is so unlike the one worshipped here.
Half a moment, your cup of tea is ready.

conversations.section: Talking to with crocspeak

pages.x: The sand feels lovely and soft between my toes.

o: You notice the crocodiles claws are pedicured.

pages.x: Your claws look lovely!
Thank you! I got them done by this amazing nail technician down in the marsh by Sophanem.
Maybe I'll have to go check them out!

conversations.section: West of Varrock / During the 25th Anniversary celebrations task with a cat follower

pages.x: I hope you're taking good care of this little cute baby.
I sure am!
I was talking to your cat.
Oh, right.
I can assure you that I am well fed and get lots of attention.

conversations.section: In Burthorpe, before While Guthix Sleeps / Without requirements to enter the Warriors' Guild

pages.x: Welcome to Warriors' Guild!
Can I join?
Maybe! You go and become warrior and we see!
I am a warrior!
Then you go and become stronger warrior!

pages.x: I'm ready to take an order now...

for cooking training and Blurberry the barman for cocktail making training. Once I get recommendations from both of them, you'll be able to start work for me.
So that's Aluft Gianne snr. for cooking training, and Blurberry for Cocktail training?
That's right - Good luck!

conversations.section: Blue / Conversation 10

pages.x: Hi.

A warning traveller! The new world will rise from the underground!

Just a warning!

You look happy.
I'm always at peace with myself.
How do you manage that?
I know, therefore I am.

conversations.section: Green / Conversation 10

Why don't you make like a tree...
...and leave!

Hello, are you alright?

So?!

Bla bla bla!

Bla bla bla!
Rude little gnome!

pages.x: The cards are with me, yes. Something so precious can not be left unattended. Let me see.

pages.x: Hello.
Good day, can I help you?

No. Go away.
No. I'm busy.

conversations.section: Dialogue

Thanks. I'll look out for them.

Brutes!

Indeed.

pages.x: And relax.

Feel free to pass on my words to others who follow.

There's trouble in town, and a lot of villagers have left as a result. Things are looking dire.

The device he built must have been very complicated indeed.
I'd say! Anyway, the saw looks like it could be pretty useful. Thanks.

RuneScape turns [18/19/20/21/22/23/24/25] today! There are balloon drops every 30 minutes around most lodestones to celebrate!
This sounds fun!

Yes, his army was led by an ancient hero Arrav, who Zemouregal had managed to enslave.
A man named Dimintheis managed to defeat the zombie army with an artefact called the Shield of Arrav. Oh, and I helped quite a lot, if I do say so myself.

conversations.section: I have more information about the Mahjarrat / Hazeel Cult

pages.x: I've found out about a slain Mahjarrat named Hazeel. There's a whole cult dedicated to reviving him in Ardougne.
So this cult is helping the Mahjarrat?
Yes, they said they're faithful to Lord Zamorak, and seem to be in awe of the Mahjarrats' power.
It's fascinating how people of a particular nature flock to power.

conversations.section: Talk-to / On free-to-play worlds

pages.x: Hello there. Could I ask you about the-
Not at the moment, I'm afraid! It's not nearly safe enough to talk right now.
But you don't even know what I was going to ask!
Oh, I have enough of an idea to know that it's not safe enough to talk about it on a free world.

conversations.section: Outside of War's Retreat / With a combat level below 60, but at least 1,000 skill total

pages.x: Sorry, Player I can't let you join me in combat here until you are stronger, I wouldn't want you to get seriously hurt. Combat level 60 should be enough!
Hmm... On second thought, you do look very skilled. Maybe I could make an exception?
Yes, I'll let you in. I will take no responsibility should you get hurt, however.

pages.i: Do you want to enter War's Retreat without at least combat level 60?

conversations.section: After Lost City

pages.x: Hey, thanks for all the information. It REALLY helped me out in finding the lost city of Zanaris and all.
Oh, please don't say that anymore! If the rest of my party knew I'd helped you, they'd probably throw me out and make me walk home by myself!
So anyway, what have you found out? Where is the fabled Zanaris? Is it all the legends say it is?
You know...I think I'll keep that to myself.

conversations.section: With at least the medium Desert tasks, and before claiming potato cacti for the day / Conversation 2

pages.x: She likes to be tickled hehehehe.
Okay...
About my potato cacti...
Oh, them. Not got none of them. Got some paper, though. Here, you can have it… before they get it.

conversations.section: At the entrance to the Werewolf Agility Course / Talking to him / With the ring of Charos equipped

pages.x: What's beneath the trapdoor?
It's an agility course designed for lycanthropes like ourselves, my friend.
Can I come in and use it?
Certainly. The cavern contains two courses: on the west side is a level 60 Agility Course, and on the east side is a level 25 Skullball Course.

conversations.section: On free-to-play worlds

pages.x: Hello!
Blast! I was in the middle of my magical meditations - now you've gone and spoiled it! Why did you have to interrupt me?
Oh, sorry. I was just trying to be friendly.
Never mind! Good day to you, sir.

conversations.section: NovtumberFest / Helping with the research

pages.x: Would you like to help with my research?
Well that's disappointing.

conversations.section: Before Rune Mysteries and Rune Memories

pages.x: What can I do for you on this glorious day, adventurer?
I am the Wizard Ellaron. Grand Master of the Order of Saradomin; Initiate into the Inner Circle of the Rune Mysteries; Heir to the Sacred Tradition of the Staff of Fire.
Impressive, no? We wizards love to invent titles for ourselves. All it really means is that I'm one of the senior wizards of the tower.

conversations.section: Historical dialogue / Using runes on him

pages.x: runes, eh? Fascinating... Should I recommend those to other for their experiments?

o: runes: Do you recommend these to other players?

pages.x: Splendid! I'll share this knowledge with the world.

conversations.section: Trade option

pages.x: I'd like to buy a pouch.
Ah, coins to fund my rock collection.

o: Buy a large pouch for 25,000 gp.
Buy a giant pouch for 50,000 gp.
pages.i: Which pouch would you like to buy?

pages.x: Never mind.

conversations.section: After Plague City, before Plague's End / While wearing full Mourner gear / Conversation 3

pages.x: Hello, how's it going?
You mourners... are meant to be helping us, but you're doing more harm here than good. You won't even let me send a letter out to my family.
I'm sorry but it's not down to me.
That's what you all say!

conversations.section: After Plague City, before Plague's End / While wearing full Mourner gear / Conversation 4

pages.x: Hey ya.
You better watch your back, Mourner!
Sorry, are you threatening me?
Just think of me next time you're in a dark alley! Because I'll be waiting for you.
Hiya.
What do you want? I've got work to do!
Can you teach me anything?
No - I've got one lousy apprentice already, and that's quite enough hassle! Go away!

conversations.section: At the entrance to the Lumbridge Catacombs / Before The Blood Pact

pages.x: I'm glad you've come by. I need some help.

o: What do you need help with?
How did you know who I am?

pages.x: My name's Xenia. I'm an adventurer. I'm one of the old guard, I suppose. I helped found the Champions' Guild, and I've done a fair few quests in my time.
Now I'm starting to get a bit old for action, which is why I need your help.

conversations.section: Discontinued / After Rune Mysteries

pages.x: Ariane told me how you helped rediscover the Rune Essence mine. Everyone in the Wizards' Tower is talking about you.
I know it didn't feel like it, but delivering that package marked the start of a new era.
You don't know what it was like, back in the old days. The Tower had to go cap in hand to Lunar Isle for every rune.
Every time you failed at casting a spell, that was an irreplaceable commodity gone.

conversations.section: Post-quest dialogue, before Heart of Stone / After All Fired Up

pages.x: A lot of people feel safer now that you've completed the beacon network. I know I do.
There have been so many incursions from the Wilderness over the last few decades - more than most people realise.
We need a quick way of calling heroes into action when we're threatened.
You've set up a system, and I hope you'll be there to answer the call when the beacons are lit.

conversations.section: Post-quest dialogue, before Heart of Stone / After Demon Slayer

pages.x: So, you're the hero who slew Delrith, eh?
Gypsy Aris has been predicting for years that Delrith would return, but a hero would defeat him.
For a while, I thought it might be me, then I thought it might be one of my proteges, maybe Sir Owen.
I'm glad it turned out to be you.

conversations.section: Post-quest dialogue, before Heart of Stone / In Falador Park, after While Guthix Sleeps

pages.x: You won't be forgotten. I'll make sure of it.
Saradomin shine his light upon you.

conversations.section: Talking to Yaktwee with a Yaktwee stick that can be upgraded

pages.x: Ah, Player. I see you've caught 1,000 vizzy critters recently, so I'll do you a favour and upgrade your Yaktwee stick. How about that?
There, I've improved your stick. Hope you're happy!
Your loss!

conversations.section: Standard dialogue

pages.x: Hey ya.
Can I help you?
Not really I just wanted to chat.
Sorry, I do not have time for idle gossip. Good day.

conversations.section: Treasure Trails / When talked to again

pages.x: Please enter the answer to the question.
That's not right at all.
Correct!

conversations.section: On Waiko, before Jed Hunter

pages.x: Looking for something? Or someone?
Yeah, I'm trying to track down a man called Jed. He's also known as the Iron Link.
Can't say I've heard of such a person, and I make it my business to know everyone.
Well, I guess it was a long shot. I figured he'd be quite notorious in the Arc.

conversations.section: Before mining the big sandstone boulder / When talked to / Afterwards / With logs

pages.x: Should we go ahead and make this cactus patch?
I see you have 12 Acadia logs, give them to me and I'll work on a basic plot perimeter while you mine away that boulder.
Sure, no problem.
Good. I will fashion these into planks and pegs for the edge of the cactus patch. Go ahead and mine that...thing.

conversations.section: Before mining the big sandstone boulder / When talked to / Afterwards / Without logs

pages.x: Should we go ahead and make this cactus patch?
Before I let you get started, bring me 12 Acadia logs, and I'll work on a basic plot perimeter.
Only 12?
12 Acadia logs is fine. I'm not crafting the Dominion Tower!

I'm trying to get some extra crops going, so I'll need : [Seed] x [number]
I'm also looking for a new animal, I'm currently after one of the following : [Animal], or [Animal], or [Animal], or [Animal
I'm also looking for some produce, so I'll need : [Produce] x [number]

pages.x: Here, you seem like you could use a drink.
What's the catch?
There's no catch - you're my friend, and you're tired, so I decided to buy you a drink.
Alright... Thanks, Player.

conversations.section: In Al Kharid / Handing him an Al Kharid flyer

pages.x: Hi. I have this money off voucher.
So I see. Unfortunately, it seems to have expiredyesterday. Never mind.
But I only just got it!
I'm sorry. There's nothing I can do. Goodbye.

conversations.section: Fourth task / Talking to the Curator about A Cultist's Journey / First time

pages.x: I've received word that Johanhus has left the Cathedral, but there's been no sign of him leaving Senntisten.
The last thing we want is him yelling about the Elder Gods and disheartening the troops. Go and sort him out.
Yeah, I think I'd better check.

conversations.section: Second task / Talking to the Curator about A Cultist's Journey / First time

pages.x: My sources say that Johanhus is claiming to have solved the mystery. Whether he has or not is another question entirely... He was last seen roaming the Feldip Hills.
Could you go and see if he really has managed to find anything of note?
I'll head there now...

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Cyclopes

pages.x: Cyclopes are tricky giants, originally from the far-eastern lands.
The brave warriors in the guild near Burthorpe have a collection of them; however, they are immune to anything other than melee attacks.
Other specimens aren't so tough, and can be found in the God Wars Dungeon.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Killerwatts

pages.x: Killerwatts store huge amounts of energy in their bodies, which is released if they are touched.
You'll need to wear heavily insulated boots to counter this shocking effect, plus they can attack speedily with both magic and missiles.
To access their cloudy plane, you'll need to explore Draynor Manor.

conversations.section: City Quest

pages.x: Ah, hello, are they keeping you out of the city too? Perhaps you could help me.
Wonderful.

conversations.section: Before Throne of Miscellania

pages.x: Greetings, [Sir/Madam].
The King needs someone to take over the rule of the kingdom. If I were you, I should consider the position.

o: Tell me about the Achievement System.
Could I buy a spare of the reward?

conversations.section: Collect

pages.x: Here is a list of what your subjects have collected.
I shall tell your subjects to deliver your resources to your bank right away, Your Royal Highness.
This is how your subjects are distributing their effort.

conversations.section: Standard dialogue after Plague's End

pages.x: I miss my rock... It was my special place.
I was safe and happy there, and you took it all away.
The lady you built is very pretty, though.

conversations.section: Cold War / Finishing the agility course

pages.x: Well done soldier! You've successfully completed the physical. You're free to do as you like.
What do I do now?
Just go through the gate in the fence and use the same door you came out of. You can come back whenever you like to tone up your body.

conversations.section: After There's No Place Like Home...

pages.x: I hope you're getting along well with your housing journey! Remember if you ever need a refresher on how things work, you can thumb through the Construction guidebook.
Would you like one?

conversations.section: In Al Kharid / Before The Feud, without meeting the quest requirements

pages.x: Hello, my friend. Have a look at my wares.
No, I'm really too busy.

conversations.section: Manor Farm / Hand in easy request / Before completing the request / Without requested items

pages.x: You don't have enough items to fulfil my request. I won't take favourited animals.
I'm trying to get some extra crops going, so I'll need : [Seed] x [number]
I'm also looking for a new animal, I'm currently after A [animal]

conversations.section: Before purchasing the Aminishi miststone / Without any Ports Spice

pages.x: Perhaps you would be willing to trade?
I'm looking for Ports Spice, and I'm willing to give you something precious in exchange.
I want 1 and you have 0. How about it?

conversations.section: Wandering through Anachronia / Investigating first set of bones

pages.x: Look at this.
This looks and smells fresh, but all the flesh has been stripped right off.
We're going to have to squeeze past it, be careful not to slip.

conversations.section: Wandering through Anachronia / Investigating second set of bones

pages.x: Another pile of bones, on the same track as where these footprints are leading.
Let us push on, we need to find a safe spot to make camp.
Night is upon us and we should ensure we're protected against whatever is with us on this island.

conversations.section: Manor Farm / Hand in easy request / Before completing the request / Without requested items

pages.x: You don't have enough items to fulfil my request. I won't take favourited animals.
I'm trying to get some extra crops going, so I'll need : [Seed] x [number]
I'm also looking for a new animal, I'm currently after A [animal]

conversations.section: After completing Time Served

pages.x: Nicely done with that ancient timepiece!
Yeah, it unlocked the door to the east, into what I think is the prison's higher security area.
Ooh, I bet that's where they kept all the really dangerous and serious prisoners.

conversations.section: Relics / Bringing the mortal cup to the Acting Guildmaster / Talking to Acting Guildmaster with the rewards

pages.x: Velucia handed me the relic in return for the artefact I gave her. It feels like it's drawing me towards the monolith.
Really? Now, that is unusual. We've been researching that mysterious monolith ever since Guildmaster Tony's disappearance. He was messing with it when he disappeared!
Everyone has been too wary to get close to it, though, but if that relic is pulling you towards it...

conversations.section: Screening soil / Once 10 soil has been screened

pages.x: Right, that should be enough screening. What did you find?
Screening is a good way to find any materials you might have missed, among other things.
The screening station will help you separate the soil from any useful items still hidden within it.

conversations.section: Uncovering an excavation / Using items on Reiniger / Mattocks

pages.x: Now, that is a mattock! It's an archaeologist's best friend. Never leave home without one. It's a fantastic multi-purpose tool for digging, scraping, prying and smashing.
Matty Ock has a shop inside the main campus building where he'll sell you up to rune mattocks, or you can smith one yourself with any type of metal.
There are also some special ones to find if you know where to look...

conversations.section: Uncovering an excavation / Using items on Reiniger / Other materials

pages.x: That's a material! We need to collect materials in order to restore any damaged artefacts we discover.
There are a number of materials that are commonly found across all dig sites, and a select few that are only found at specific dig sites.

The Archaeology Guild has provided a material storage chest to assist your restorations, which is accessible at all dig sites, and which can be upgraded to store more material types at the guild reward shop.

conversations.section: Conversation 1

pages.x: Hello there! How is it going?
Uh... we're not supposed to talk while we're on duty.
Oh, sorry, I didn't realise...

conversations.section: At summer events

pages.x: Foreman George continues to impress me with his sandcastle designs; I find it hard to believe there's no magic involved.
I'd love to see a magic-inspired sandcastle while I'm here.
You're not very subtle about what you want are you?

conversations.section: Quest-related / Dragon Slayer

pages.x: I wish I could have seen Crandor before it was destroyed. They had their own school of magic. One of the largest libraries in the world.
The last Crandorian wizards meant well by hiding their map pieces, but you can't hide an island forever. I'm glad you put the map back together and killed Elvarg.
Oh, and congratulations for getting into the Champions' Guild.

conversations.section: Quest-related / Heroes' Quest

pages.x: Achiettes tells me you're a member of the Heroes' Guild now. Congratulations.
It was a firebird feather, a lava eel and a thieves' armband for you, wasn't it?
I wish Achiettes would give heroes useful things to do rather than fetch arbitrary sets of items.

conversations.section: Quest-related / Legends' Quest

pages.x: I've been studying your Kharazi Jungle map. Thanks to you we finally have some concrete information about what's down there.
Just think! If we send every new Legends' Guild member to map a different place, before long we'd have a map of the whole world!
Oh, and congratulations on getting into the Legends' Guild. It's well deserved.

conversations.section: Quest-related / Rune Mechanics

pages.x: I hear the Mage Training Arena are able to make rune guardians again.
Wizard Clerval says you gave him a few pointers, but I'm guessing more of the work was yours than he would like to admit.
I hope the wizards don't leave it at recreating the old guardians. There are so many problems that could be solved by inventing new types of automaton.

conversations.section: Quest-related / Stone of Jas

pages.x: It's a shame you couldn't keep hold of the Stone this time. For studying, obviously.
Although, if Lucien hadn't inadvertently unleashed the dragonkin, we would have brought his fate upon ourselves. Such an ingenious security mechanism...
I hope we can undo the harm he's caused.

conversations.section: Quest-related / The Blood Pact

pages.x: You're the one who stopped the necromantic ritual in Lumbridge and opened Dragith Nurn's tomb, aren't you?
The Tower has banned its wizards from going down there, of course. Necromancy - dangerous forbidden knowledge.
I don't think you and I need to let that stop us. We're adventurers.

conversations.section: Quest-related / The Dig Site

pages.x: So. 'Tremble mortal, before the altar of our dread lord Zaros.' It looks like you've discovered a new god.
I've been hunting around for references to this 'Zaros'. There are a few, but not many. It's as if the other gods tried to remove all references from him.
Information is the key. I'm not going to tremble just because a piece of old stone tells me to. I hope we can find more objective information about Zaros in the future.

conversations.section: Quest-related / Tower of Life

pages.x: I hear you're the one who finished Effigy's Tower of Life.
I'm worried about the ethical implications of using the altars in the tower basement. We should be very careful when creating a being that can feel...
Which isn't to say we shouldn't do it. Magic like that could be used to cure diseases, extend our lifespans - eventually, maybe even conquer death.

conversations.section: Adventure begins / Opening cutscene

pages.x: Some heroes are born, possessing natural gifts that lift them above the ordinary. Some heroes are made. Their strength is the result of hardship and toil.
Some heroes live for adventure, confronting terrible dangers in pursuit of riches and fame. While others fight to protect those who cannot defend themselves.
But some heroes have more...unlikely origins. This is the story of one such hero. This is your story.

conversations.section: Confrontation / Discovering the church in danger

pages.x: Wait a minute – did you hear that?
It sounded like it came from the church.
Let's go!

conversations.section: First steps / Discovering the Zombie / After defeating the second Zombie

pages.x: Well done [laddie/lassie]! You fought bravely. The question is – where did those creatures come from? I've never seen anything like it in Ashdale before.
Something is wrong – very wrong. I'm not as young as I used to be, [laddie/lassie]. If there's danger coming, the task of protecting Ashdale will have to fall to you.
Anyway, let's press on. For now, we'll stick with the plan of preparing you for the journey to the mainland. But we should keep an eye out for anything unusual.

conversations.section: Food and healing / After cooking the fish

pages.x: The look nicely cooked to me! But don't eat them now – keep hold of them until you really need them.
Food's the best thing for restoring health, so you should always have a little bit with you in case you get into a fight. Now let's get started on your new sword.
That rusty old blade of yours isn't going to last much longer!

conversations.section: Standard dialogue

pages.x: This is so humilating.
What's up?
This is the last time I apply for a job by post. They pay me to sit here and 'look interesting'. They think that having a 'trained human' will help attract customers.

conversations.section: In the Merchant district of Menaphos, after The Jack of Spades / After completing the journal

pages.x: By helping to preserve this knowledge you have done a great service to the history of Menaphos.
Hopefully, this new Pharaoh will be a little less hateful of knowledge, and we will be able to properly restore the Grand Library.
But I don't know, he seems pretty suspicious.

conversations.section: Wearing the chicken outfit / Talk to

pages.x: What on Gielinor are you wearing?
It's my chicken suit. I saved Easter and was given it as a reward.
You're not impressing anyone walking around like that. Why don't you go...cross a road or something.

conversations.section: At the Clan Camp / Normally / If the player is not in a clan

pages.x: You! Yes, you! Do you have a clan? Are you a high-ranking member? Can you procure followers for me?
I'm not in a clan; sorry.
Bah! Then you cannot help. Useless! Useless! Someone bring me the minio... the helpers I need!

conversations.section: After Monkey Madness / As any other monkey

pages.x: Hello stranger, what can I do for you?
I'm just exploring.
Well stranger, feel free to explore my kingdom for as long as you like.

conversations.section: After Recipe for Disaster

pages.x: Hello again, I do anything for you?
Not really, just popping in to say hi.
Well, enjoy the .

pages.x: Got any more chimp ices?
Not on me.
Well bring me some more, you've only brought me [number], after all.

conversations.section: Using the broomstick from Swept Away on her

pages.x: Could you enchant this broom for me?
Ah, this looks like Maggie's broom. Of course I can enchant it for you. Just one moment.
Excellent! Many thanks.

conversations.section: Using the broomstick from Swept Away on her / If already enchanted

pages.x: Could you enchant this broom for me?
Hmm, I've already enchanted that for you.
Oh, right.

conversations.section: In East Ardougne market

pages.x: Good day, monsieur. Would you like ze nice freshly-baked bread? Or perhaps a nice piece of cake?
No thank you.

conversations.section: Talk to / After completing Visions of Havenhythe / After completing Trader Woes

pages.x: Just picture the trading vessels that'll be coming in, and the wares they'll be carrying. Oh, I can't wait!
We may need a bigger pier.
One problem at a time.

conversations.section: After Desert Treasure

pages.x: So you're the fella that freed Azzanadra, huh? Fair play to ya. What will you have?
Didn't feel like a drink after all, huh? Well, stop by anytime, hero.

conversations.section: Talk-to / Normally

pages.x: Bzzzzzzzzzzzz.

Bzz Bzzz Bzz Bzzzz Bzz Bzz.

I have more useless old lamps you can have in return - my master will never run out of these.

conversations.section: Before Garden of Tranquility

pages.x: Do you know anything about grapevine diseases?
No, I'm afraid I don't.
Oh, that's a shame. I hope I find someone soon, otherwise I could lose all of this year's crop.

conversations.section: With catspeak

pages.x: Hey! What are you doing? This is my barrel, you hear? MINE! Get out of here before I scratch you into tiny pieces!
I'll leave you be.
Yeah! You better run!

conversations.section: Cocktail training / Fruit Blast

pages.x: Hello Blurberry.
Hi, are you ready to make your first cocktail?
Absolutely.
