pages.x: I'm doing the NovtumberFest Bar crawl.
Ah, you've come to the best stop on your list! The best drink that we have got; a drunk dragon! It'll cost you 10 coins.

o: 10 coins have been removed from your money pouch.
Your mouth and throat burn as you gulp it down.

conversations.section: Cat Rulebook / Cat Rule 4

pages.x: Cat Rule number 4: Beware the bag monster. These things live in small bags and under newspapers, sometimes even hidden in shoes if they are very clever.
They will be very small and take on the same colour as the hiding place. Attack these things on sight - stop at nothing.
If you see a bag or shoe you have not inspected recently, pounce!!

pages.x: Dogs believe they are human. Cats believe they are Guthix!

Well I don’t believe much really since I know I am Zar... erm, well, no, I erm, meow?

conversations.section: After Tower of Life

Yeah, we need another job. But til then, we figured we may as well wait ta see what else would turns up.

Sounds like you have a story to tell.
Not untill I get to know you a whole lot better. That's a tale I prefer to keep to myself.

pages.x: Thanks again for the hangover cure.

I'm just having a little drop of whisky, then I'll feel really good.

Do you-

pages.x: Hello.
Be vigilant, citizen.

conversations.section: In the Troll Stronghold / After Eadgar's Ruse / Without meeting the requirements for My Arm's Big Adventure

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Aberrant spectres

pages.x: Aberrant spectres are fetid, vile ghosts. The very smell of them will paralyse and harm you.
A nosepeg will help negate their stink and their attacks are most definitely magical in nature.
You'll be able to make the world more fragrant if you kill the ones lurking in the Slayer Tower near Canifis.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Bloodveld

pages.x: Bloodveld are strange, demonic creatures. They use their long, rasping tongue to feed on just about anything they can find.
Their tongue assaults physically, so using magic attacks might be the best choice.
If you can stand being licked by a half-ton demon, you should take a trip to the Slayer Tower near Canifis.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Fungal magi

pages.x: Fungal magi live in the upper levels of a cave north-east of the Mage Training Arena.
The creatures of that dungeon are coated in toxic fungus, so you should fight them from a distance, and be prepared for their magical attacks.
The fungus helps them repair physical damage, so you might prefer using magical attacks too.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Grifolapines

pages.x: Grifolapines live in a cave north-east of the Mage Training Arena.
The creatures of that dungeon are coated in toxic fungus, so you should fight them from a distance, and dodge when they charge at you.
The fungus helps them repair physical damage, so you might prefer using magical attacks.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Grifolaroos

pages.x: Grifolaroos live in a cave north-east of the Mage Training Arena.
The creatures of that dungeon are coated in toxic fungus, so you should fight them from a distance, although they'll try to hop over obstacles towards you.
The fungus helps them repair physical damage, so you might prefer using magical attacks.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Ganodermic creatures

I'm Player and I need to make a fire for Sir Vant. Can you help?
Of course I can! You'll be needing a tinderbox. First, let me guide you around my store.

conversations.section: Inventory / Talking to Sir Vant

pages.x: Well done! You'll look back on this moment fondly, I'm sure. Most monsters will drop items that you can pick up, and the items will come in all shapes and sizes.
We call them 'loot' or 'drops'.

conversations.section: Smithing / Talking to the Smelting Tutor

pages.x: Hi, are you the Smelting Tutor? I understand you can teach me about making metal bars.
Aye, my name's Feoras, and I can indeed teach you about smelting ores. I'm technically just an apprentice, but don't let that worry you!
I know everything there is to know about smelting.

conversations.section: Woodcutting / Talking to the Woodcutting Tutor / Without the logs

pages.x: What happened to the logs you chopped from the tree?
I'm not sure.
No matter. Just cut some more.

conversations.section: Before obtaining two pages / Afterwards

pages.x: Any joy figuring out this door yet?
Not yet.
Well, keep calm and carry on excavating! That's what me ol'Da always used to say. In the meantime, I'll keep searching for the missing dial.

conversations.section: Talk to / Before completing Hearts of Sanguine

pages.x: Hello. I-
Yes, yes, hello. Small talk will have to wait - I'm dealing with an ore shortage over here.
I'll leave you to it, then.

conversations.section: South of Eagles' Peak, without the skill requirements to start The Firemaker's Curse

pages.x: What are you all doing here?
Top secret, my friend. But perhaps when you're more experienced you could help us.
I see.

conversations.section: Repeatable dialogue / Between a Rock...

pages.x: Dondakan says you made a gold helmet. Like, a solid gold one, not one with gold decorations?
Normally a silly idea. Gold's too soft, too heavy. But it got you inside a new gold mine! Who knew?
Hope you enjoy all the gold. It's not very useful, really, but it's considered valuable and it looks pretty, I guess, so whatever.

conversations.section: Repeatable dialogue / Catapult Construction

pages.x: So, I heard you fixed the catapult at, what's it called, Tyras camp. Yeah.
Good work. Harder than it looks. I mean, it's just a thing that chucks a rock, but it's not just a thing that chucks rocks, you know? It's got to be precise.
You don't want rocks going just anywhere.

conversations.section: Repeatable dialogue / Death Plateau

pages.x: So, Denulth. Heard you and he are friends now, after you did that thing with the trolls and the plateau and the climbing boots and whatever.
Funny weapon, claws. Imperial Guard like them. Not sure they're worth the effort. Fiddly. So many moving parts. Scare value I suppose.
Make you look like some kind of monster.

conversations.section: Repeatable dialogue / The Golem

pages.x: Hey, so, I heard you repaired a statue, in the desert. Not an actual statue, a construct. A golem!
I thought about learning to make one, but there's too much magic involved. Besides...
Would you really want to trust a construct to fight for you? Me, I'd rather have a good, balanced sword.

conversations.section: Repeatable dialogue / The Knight's Sword

pages.x: Hey, you're the one who forged Sir Whatsisname's blurite sword. Sir Vyvin. Thurgo told me.
Good work, nice. Had to look closely to see the difference.
Don't worry, your secret's safe with me. Sir V has nooo idea.

conversations.section: Repeatable dialogue / Tower of Life

pages.x: Hey, heard you were a builder now. I mean, not just someone who builds stuff, a capital-B Builder, one of Bonafido's lot.
With the outfit, and the tea and the whistling and the not actually doing any work.
'Cept Bonafido says you finished that tower while he and his lot sat around outside. One-man construction team. Good stuff.

conversations.section: After The Fremennik Trials

pages.x: You can't go through there. Talent only, backstage.
But I'm a Bard!
No you're not. I saw your performance. I was paid well to keep you from ever setting foot on stage here again.

conversations.section: Talk to / Standard dialogue / For the "of the Amlodd" title

pages.x: Behold, the great Lord Amlodd! Returned, from the plane of sp-!
Oh, I've done that part already. Anything I can help you with, Player?
Or perhaps it's you that should be helping me - you're as enlightened as any Amlodd!

conversations.section: After Regicide and before Plague's End / Without wearing full Mourner gear

pages.x: Good day, Lord Iorwerth.
Ahh Player. Good day, sorry I cannot stop to talk. So much to do, so little time.
Very well, good bye.

conversations.section: Talk to / While not on Kili's tier 90 tank task or after having talked to Kili about ScapeRune

pages.x: They always used to say you can sleep when you're dead, but here I am still working away. *sigh*
Still, want to see what I've got in stock?

conversations.section: Conversation 1 / Conversation 2

pages.x: Heigh ho, heigh ho, cake-hunting we shall go!
Something, something, cake and jam.
I think you might need to work on the words for that.

conversations.section: Conversation 1 / When used on a POH toy box

pages.x: Wow, look at all these cool toys!
Go on, in you get.
That box is for toys, not turkeys! Silly person.

conversations.section: After Evil Dave's Big Day Out

pages.x: Nice to see you again in your actual body. I assume everything went well on the whole getting-your-body-back front.
It did indeed!
Great to hear – now what can I do for you?

conversations.section: Without all the jewellery

pages.x: Oh you're here about the Jewellery, let's see what you have.
Sorry, you don't have all the things I need yet.
Bring me a Diamond Ring, an Emerald Necklace and a Ruby Bracelet.

conversations.section: Between Plague City and Plague's End / While not wearing full Mourner gear / Man #1 (wearing beige shirt and brown pants)

pages.x: Good day.
An outsider! Can you get me out of this hell hole?
Sorry, that's not what I'm here to do.

conversations.section: After Quiet Before the Swarm

pages.x: He's dead! He's dead! My Mikhal is dead!
Maybe you should go back to the mainland, see some family?
And leave his grave? Never! I'm going to stay here, with him.

conversations.section: After Plague City

pages.x: Any luck finding Elena yet?
Yes, she is safe at home now.
That's good to hear, she helped us a lot.

conversations.section: Talking to the masterwork fanatic

pages.x: Wow, what is that you are wearing?
I'm wearing masterwork armour. You will be able to smith it yourself in the upcoming Mining and Smithing rework.
Oh wow! Do you have more information about the rework?

conversations.section: Talking to the masterwork fanatic

pages.x: Wow, what is that you are wearing?
I'm wearing trimmed masterwork armour. You will be able to smith it yourself in the upcoming Mining and Smithing rework.
Oh wow! Do you have more information about the rework?

conversations.section: If the player is wearing the silly jester outfit

pages.x: Ah, jester. I am no longer in need of jest.
If my Champion wishes to talk with me, he should dress as one.

o: The Burgher gives you a wink.

conversations.section: In Lumbridge during the 25th Anniversary celebrations

pages.x: I'm so close to inverting my max cape colours...
Can't you just do that any time you want?
Not before I've unlocked all the inverted skillcapes - that would be cheating!

conversations.section: Using the broomstick from Swept Away on her

pages.x: Could you enchant this broom for me?
Ah, this is Maggie's broom, isn't it? Yes, I can enchant it for you. Just one moment.
Excellent! Many thanks.

conversations.section: Using the broomstick from Swept Away on her / If already enchanted

pages.x: Could you enchant this broom for me?
Eh? I've already enchanted that for you.
Oh, right.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Cyclopes

pages.x: Cyclopes are tricky giants, originally from the far-eastern lands.
The brave warriors in the guild near Burthorpe have a collection of them; however, they are immune to anything other than melee attacks.
Other specimens aren't so tough, and can be found in the God Wars Dungeon.

conversations.section: Special Slayer challenge / Using an enchanted gem near a Morytanian fairy ring / West of Canifis / After defeating the ravenous ghoul

pages.x: Are you okay, Player?
Yes, I think so.
Hmm, this does not bode well. We had best continue our investigation with the other rings in the swamplands and the haunted woods.

conversations.section: After the hotfix of 17 January 2022 / At Het's Oasis / With catspeak

pages.x: Enjoying yourself, Medjed?
There are many mice here to smite. I shall grace this place with my divine presence a little while longer.
Good to hear.

conversations.section: After Birthright of the Dwarves / Klaas / Spared / With the Consortium in power and Veldaban dead

pages.x: Rest in peace King Veldaban, last true king of Keldagrim.

o: So now you think Veldaban is legitimate?
What do you think of the Consortium now?

conversations.section: After Birthright of the Dwarves / Meike / With the Consortium in power and Veldaban dead

pages.x: Hello again, Player.

o: How do you think the Consortium is doing now?

pages.x: Halt!
Take another step and we'll fill you with arrows.
Menaphos is closed to you Sophanites. Turn back and take whatever plague you have with you.

conversations.section: Unlocking Perdita

pages.x: Player! You've helped me a great deal with saving Solak from Erethdor!
Please take this as a token of my gratitude, in the hope that she too, will guide you as she did me.

conversations.section: In the Dorgeshuun mines / Using a brooch on him, after The Lost Tribe quest

pages.x: Is this your brooch?
Yes! I thought I'd lost it. Thank you.
Have one of these helmets. It will be useful if you want to work in the mine.

conversations.section: Officer training / Getting squads

pages.x: What should I be doing now?
It's time to go get some squads! Go to the squad recruiters in the south-west building of this compound.
I've already given you 1,000 investment credits, which should cover the expense.

conversations.section: Officer training / Getting squads / Returning to Junior Cadet Mal / After hiring 10 squads

pages.x: Got 10 squads?
Yep!
Okay, go get some special units. I'll add 2,000 investment credits to your A.R.M.S. account.

conversations.section: Officer training / Getting squads / Talking to a recruiter / First time

pages.x: I believe you can help me recruit some squads.
Definitely!

Go to the tables under the tent in the north-east corner of this compound.

o: Not yet. Can I see the list please?

pages.x: Silly fishy! You lookin' like likkle Mogre wid your likkle arms an' wid your likkle legs!
Swim along silly round head fishy!
Dont let dem big skippies eat you!

conversations.section: Dropping the monkey outside of Karamja, then talking to it

pages.x: Hello there, monkey.
Are we there yet??
Not quite yet ... you should get back in my backpack now.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Aquanites

pages.x: Aquanites are amphibious creatures that attract prey using the glowing lures on their heads.
They attack stronger opponents from a distance with water magic, and dislike those who pray against it.
They dwell in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, in a chamber past the kurasks.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Celestial dragons

pages.x: Celestial dragons are one of the strangest dragons I assign.
They use melee but also have a powerful dragonfire attack, as well as a fascinating ability to momentarily stop time.
You can find them in the depths of Dragontooth Island.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Cres's automatons

pages.x: Without their master, Cres's automatons roam Guthix's chambers attacking any who enter.
They are programmed to use magic, melee or ranged and can perform a violent area-of-effect attack.
Guthix's chambers may be reached via his shrine, or the excavation west of the Legends' Guild.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Ganodermic creatures

pages.x: Ganodermic beasts and runts live in the depths of a cave north-east of the Mage Training Arena.
The creatures of that dungeon are coated in toxic fungus, so you should fight them from a distance.
The fungus helps them repair physical damage, so you might prefer using magical attacks.

conversations.section: In West Ardougne / While wearing full Mourner gear / Attempting to enter the Mourner HQ with select non-Mourner items

pages.x: You should know better than to wear non-regulation gear.
Sorry, I'm new around here.
Well, you know the drill - lose the gear, I will let it pass this time.

conversations.section: After Quiet Before the Swarm

pages.x: I heard about the landing party. All those young people...and the Commodore...
I guess you're glad you stopped Terry from becoming a knight, huh?
Yes, but now he knows a pain that won't leave him for the rest of his life. Maybe I should reconsider, let him train...it might help take his mind off things.

conversations.section: Livid Farm / Talk-to

pages.x: What's the matter?
The chef on my ship keeps feeding me the sloppy leftover food! He really doesn't like me.
If you cast Vengeance Other on me, it should help me a great deal when delivering secret revenge next time I'm aggravated by them!

Sorry, I didn't mean offence, what would you like to know?

o: Can I try and wear it?
pages.i: What would you like to ask?

pages.x: No thanks, I'll take a look around out here.

pages.x: Hello.
Ow!
Keep your foreign magicks out of my head!

conversations.section: Conversations

pages.x: Aren't you tired?
Yep! But it's worth it to see the water turn into a beautiful glistening pool. I plan on going for a dip after I'm done!
Just watch out for the scarabs and crocodiles...

conversations.section: Talk to

pages.x: If you're looking for a tailor, you've come to the right place.
If you're looking for a potter so careless that he ruined a season's supply of perfectly good cloth, you'll find my husband across the street.
He's not allowed in the house during work hours anymore.

conversations.section: Senntisten / Use items / Lucky dragonkin coin

pages.x: Hey, my lucky coin! Thank you for returning it to me. It really means a lot, you see. My grandmother passed it down to me and-
AGH! NO!
Oh. I guess I'll just have to find a new one, then.

conversations.section: During Mega May, at Player-owned ports / Talking to Jemi / First time

pages.x: Hi the- Oh, good Guthix...it's you! I mean, it's really you! I am such a fan! I've been following your adventures for - well, -forever! I'm an adventurer myself.
Well, okay, I'm not a proper adventurer - certainly not of your calibre - but I've been on a couple of adventures. Okay, one.
Okay, so I daydreamed about an adventure, but it's something I really want to do! I'm Jemi by the way... I..erm...already know your name.

conversations.section: At the Ectofuntus / After Vessel of the Harbinger

pages.x: Still licking your wounds?
Rasial! The cheek of him!
I hope you wipe that smug off his bony little face, Player.

conversations.section: On Crandor

pages.x: Now I see why all the other captains said I'd be mad to go near Crandor. It looks like we're stranded.
Don't worry about that. I found a secret passage in the dragon's lair that leads off the island!
Oh, that's good. I'll be able to get back to Draynor somehow, if I can sneak past all the skeletons and demons on this island!

conversations.section: After A Shadow over Ashdale

pages.x: Hello.
Alright, alright, don't get too familiar. You might have saved the town, but you should still show your elders the proper respect!

conversations.section: In Morytania / After Ghosts Ahoy

pages.x: I'm here about Necrovarus.
Good news - the enchantment worked!
So Necrovarus has let the ghosts go free... You have achieved many wonderful things, my young friend.

conversations.section: In Morytania / Using the broomstick from Swept Away on her

pages.x: Could you enchant this broom for me?
Oh, this must be Maggie's broom. I suppose I could enchant it, just this once, for old times' sake. Just one moment...
Excellent! Many thanks.

conversations.section: With catspeak

pages.x: Dude! Dude! You got any...you know...any of the green stuff? I just need a bit to, you know, get me through the day.
I don’t think I should enable your catnip problem.
Way to spoil the party, dude. You should mellow out a bit.

conversations.section: Talk to / Normally / Without rewards to claim / With the first Blooming Burrow Egg Hunt in progress

pages.x: Welcome back, Player. It looks like you've still got some eggs left to find around the burrow.
Come speak with me again once you've found them all and I'll share the details of the other egg-citing hunts!

conversations.section: After Plague's End

pages.x: The plague itself was a fake, but the image of West Ardougne as a plague city wasn't too far from the truth. Malnutrition, poor sanitation...
it's no wonder these people aren't healthy.
Now that we can get in and out again, people are getting healthier, but it'll be a long time before West Ardougne is really a nice place to live.

conversations.section: After Observatory Quest / Before receiving the jug of wine / After receiving the jug of wine

pages.x: How was the wine?
That was good stuff, *hic*! Wheresh the professher?
The professor? He's up in the Observatory. Since the bridge was ruined, you will have to travel through the dungeon under the goblins' settlement.

conversations.section: At the Feldip Hills

pages.x: Dad says you can get a lift to Karamja with us if you want? But you's gives us two chompy first!

o: Yes please, I'll get a lift to Karamja with you.

pages.x: No thanks.

conversations.section: At Gu'Tanoth / Before Watchtower / North-western gate / Afterwards

pages.x: Well, what proof of friendship did you bring?
I don't have anything.
Why have you returned with no proof of companionship? Back to whence you came!

conversations.section: Standard dialogue

pages.x: Oh, a human, I don't have time for you.
I just want to know a little bit more about your company. You're new here, aren't you?
That is none of your concern! Get out before I have the Black Guard throw you out!

conversations.section: At Memorial to Guthix / After the tutorial / With charged engrams

pages.x: I've charged this engram with divine energy and some memory strands. Could you please take a look at it?
This is perfect! I can feel the energies of the past radiating from this engram.
I will add the echo to the pool and harness its power for you. For free, of course, though I wouldn't mind a pat on the back every now and then.

conversations.section: At Memorial to Guthix / Returning with the charged Naragi engram

pages.x: I've charged this engram with divine energy and some memory strands. Could you please take a look at it?
This is perfect! I can feel the energies of the past radiating from this engram.
I will add the echo to the pool and harness its power for you. For free, of course, though I wouldn't mind a pat on the back every now and then.

conversations.section: At the Divination camp / Talk to / After completing the 10 introductory Divination achievements

pages.x: First, I'd like to give you a reward for learning the basics of divination. You've shown real dedication!

o: You receive 500 pieces of flickering energy!

pages.x: Use them wisely.

conversations.section: In Burthorpe

pages.x: Can you remember now too? I had forgotten. We had all forgotten. Now I know we have to go! The Memorial to Guthix has been waiting for us to remember.
Shall we go together?

pages.i: Teleport to the Memorial to Guthix?

conversations.section: After tier 41 of Journey to Iaia

pages.x: Thanks for the assistance Player. Luke the Gurh seems much happier now.
I'll get these supplies shipped off shortly. Do pay a visit to my friends on the island if you get a chance.
I hear they're creating some items of interest with a nice young lady.

conversations.section: Repeatable dialogue / Defender of Varrock

pages.x: Hartwin tells me that you were there when those zombies attacked Varrock. I was there too - we must have missed each other.
I guess I should thank you for saving the city! We can't let Varrock be destroyed. It's where I keep all my things!
And all the things that aren't mine yet, but I'll get around to stealing someday...

conversations.section: Repeatable dialogue / Demon Slayer

pages.x: I found Sir Prysin in the Blue Moon Inn the other day, telling everyone how he single-handedly defeated Delrith!
Don't worry, I set the record straight and told everyone it was you who killed the demon.
After that, I turned the conversation back around to myself and my own fantastic demon-slaying exploits, of course! I can't let your reputation to surpass mine!

conversations.section: Repeatable dialogue / Ilona

pages.x: So, the other day, I went out with a cute wizard apprentice, Ilona, and she told me how you rescued her from a cult in the Lumbridge Catacombs.
I told her some stories about my adventures, but she kept turning the conversation back to you!
If anyone asks about the time you and I got shipwrecked together and had to fight a horde of zombie trolls, or the time I saved you from the lair of the fire spiders, just nod, okay?

conversations.section: Repeatable dialogue / Master Thief of RuneScape

pages.x: I'm going to have to step up my game, Player!
After what you did for Darren Lightfinger and his guild, it looks like I've got a challenger for the title of Master Thief of RuneScape!
I'll need to steal something truly epic. Perhaps the Crown Jewels of Falador...or the River Salve...

conversations.section: Repeatable dialogue / Olaf the Bard

pages.x: Olaf the Bard has been repeating the song you played in the Rellekka Longhall! It sounds like you're a contender for RuneScape's second-best musician.
The very best being me, of course!
I often play on the enchanted Fremennik harp. It's true! But when I tell Olaf of that, he accuses me of being dishonest.

conversations.section: Repeatable dialogue / Poetry and Love

pages.x: Did you hear? Gudrun is settling down! She's marrying a dwarf poet!
I guess that means no more nights out on the town with her. All the times she drank me under the table at the Blue Moon Inn...
If poetry can make someone marry you, I'd better watch out! I don't want to wake up one morning and find I'd accidentally gotten married the night before!

conversations.section: Repeatable dialogue / The Champion of Crandor

pages.x: Hey, you're the Champion of Crandor! Eviscerator of Elvarg! Dragon's Doom!
How Elvarg burned Crandor used to be one of my standard stories, but no one wants to hear it any more - they want to hear how you killed the dragon.
So, congratulations: you've become a story, and you've earned me a few storytelling coins in the taverns around here.

conversations.section: RuneFest Treasure Island / Conversation 1

pages.x: Fancy seeing you here Pete, how's things?
I've seen lots of people rocking a cool new hairdo.
I'd try it myself, but I just couldn't bear to lose the 'fro!

conversations.section: RuneFest Treasure Island / Conversation 3

pages.x: Fancy seeing you here Pete, how's things?
Pretty radical dude! Although, from time to time this dragon comes after me, but I'm in control of the situation now.
Every time he attacks me I end up taming the beast and partying like no man's partied before! So if I'm not here partying you know where I am.

conversations.section: Path System / Challenge System tutorial / Upon handing in all Basic Challenges

pages.x: Nice work out there, you've ticked off all my basic challenges. Not such a rookie after all!
Now that's all done you can see all the tasks I have for you, but I'll only reward you for the daily challenges I assign you specifically.
Oh and one more thing, I found a baby troll sniffing around my things. Could you look after it for me? Thanks!

conversations.section: Day 6

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Aquanites

pages.x: Aquanites are amphibious creatures that attract prey using the glowing lures on their heads.
They attack stronger opponents from a distance with water magic, and dislike those who pray against it.
You'll find these despicable, slimy creatures in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, in a chamber past the kurasks.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Bloodveld

pages.x: Bloodveld are strange, demonic creatures that use their long rasping tongue to feed on just about anything.
They are rather robust but frankly feeble and have been seen in the Slayer Tower near Canifis, among other places.
I never liked the look of them, so off you go and wipe them out.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Cres's automatons

pages.x: Without their master, Cres's automatons roam Guthix's chambers, attacking any who enter.
They are programmed to use magic, melee or ranged and do a violent area-of-effect attack.
Guthix's chambers may be reached via his shrine, or the excavation west of the Legends' Guild.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Fungal magi

pages.x: Fungal magi live in the upper levels of a cave north-east of the Mage Training Arena.
The creatures of that dungeon are coated in toxic fungus, so you should fight them from a distance, and be prepared for their magical attacks.
The fungus helps them repair physical damage, so you might prefer using magical attacks too.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Grifolapines

pages.x: Grifolapines live in a cave north-east of the Mage Training Arena.
The creatures of that dungeon are coated in toxic fungus, so you should fight them from a distance, and dodge when they charge at you.
The fungus helps them repair physical damage, so you might prefer using magical attacks.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Grifolaroos

pages.x: Grifolaroos live in a cave north-east of the Mage Training Arena.
The creatures of that dungeon are coated in toxic fungus, so you should fight them from a distance, although they'll try to hop over obstacles towards you.
The fungus helps them repair physical damage, so you might prefer using magical attacks.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Spiritual mages

pages.x: Spiritual mages are the strongest of the spiritual guardians. They are devastating against warriors, but a smart ranger can often defeat them.
They can be found in the icy God Wars Dungeon near Trollheim, supporting the cause of their chosen god.
All these gods must be caused to lament; go slay their followers for me.

conversations.section: The bookcase / Preface

pages.x: We are TokHaar-Hok. When it is necessary, we rise up, and speak for the TokHaar. We are the voice of the masters. When the masters wish to speak, they speak through us.
The TokHaar-Hok hear the words of the masters. Only the TokHaar-Hok are strong enough to channel the voice of the masters.
Only the TokHaar-Hok can hope to voice the incomprehensible thoughts of the masters. The TokHaar-Hok are the voice caste. We listen, we speak, and all TokHaar obey.

conversations.section: The bookcase / The Hollow Victory

pages.x: After many failures - imperfect worlds wrought with crude tools - the masters succeeded. They created their final, perfect world.
The masters fulfilled their great longing. They cast aside their tools, for they no longer had need of them.
Jas set down the Elder Stone: the artefact that most purely expressed her power. The masters lay down upon their perfect world. The masters...speak no more.

conversations.section: The bookcase / The Masters

pages.x: The masters are few in number, but their power is unequalled. They are primordial elders, older than all things. They are the mothers. They are the creators.
Jas is time, and so time passes. She is sand, and so there is desert. She created the Elder Stone. Ful is constancy: the ever-burning flame.
She is fire, and so there is lava. She created the Elder Kiln.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Aberrant spectres

pages.x: Aberrant spectres are fetid, vile ghosts. The very smell of them will paralyse and harm you.
A nosepeg will help you ignore their stink and make you fight at full capacity. Sniff them out in the Slayer Tower in Morytania.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Basilisks

pages.x: Basilisks, like cockatrices, have a gaze which will paralyse and harm their prey. You'll need a mirror shield to protect you.
Basilisks live in the Rellekka Slayer Caves, along with their cockatrice relatives.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Bloodvelds

pages.x: Bloodveld are strange, demonic creatures that use their long, rasping tongue to feed on just about anything they can find.
If you wish to slay some, they live in the Slayer Tower to the north-west of Canifis.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Brine rats

pages.x: Brine rats can be found in caves near to the sea. They are hairless, bad-tempered and generally unfriendly.
If you have found Olaf's pirate treasure, you'll know where to find these targets.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Cockatrices

pages.x: Cockatrices, like basilisks, have a gaze which will paralyse and harm their prey. You'll need a mirror shield to protect you.
If you are brave enough, head to Slayer Caves east of Rellekka.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Crocodiles

pages.x: Crocodiles are large reptiles that live in the Kharidian Desert near water.
River crocodiles are a bigger challenge than the ones found next to the ocean in the south east.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Desert lizards

pages.x: Desert lizards are large reptiles with tough skin. They're cold-blooded, so dousing them with freezing water will finish them off after a tough battle.
You can find them to the east of Sophanem.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Dogs

pages.x: Dogs are much like wolves; they are pack creatures that will hunt in groups.
I've heard there are fearsome wild dogs beneath Karamja, or near Ardougne if you are less adventurous.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Ghouls

pages.x: Ghouls aren't undead, but they are stronger and tougher than they look. They're also very cowardly and will run if they're losing a fight.
They wait to ambush those entering the graveyard to the North of Canifis.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Grotworms

pages.x: Grotworms have recently been spotted in a cave near Rimmington.
The younger specimens haven't fully developed their mandibles yet, and will attack with some sort of acid spit.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Ice giants

pages.x: Like other giants, ice giants often wield large weapons. Try using fire spells to melt them before they can hit you.
Ice giants can be found underground to the south of Port Sarim.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Infernal mages

pages.x: Infernal mages are dangerous spell users; beware of their Magic spells and go properly prepared.
They have taken over an area upstairs in the Slayer Tower, plotting your doom.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Jellies

pages.x: Jellies are nasty, cube-like gelatinous creatures that absorb everything they come across.
Their acidic touch attacks in the same fashion as many magics, so prepare your armour beforehand. They keep parts of Rellekka Slayer Caves clean.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Lesser demons

pages.x: Lesser demons are magic creatures, so they are weak to ranged attacks. Although they're relatively weak, they are still dangerous.
Taverley Dungeon is home to these foul creatures.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Molanisks

pages.x: Molanisks are subterranean creatures. You can find them in caves deep below the ground.
I heard that the goblins have recently had trouble with some, but they use a bell to lure them from the cave wall.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Moss giants

pages.x: Like other giants, moss giants often wield large weapons. Use fire spells to burn them to cinders before they can damage you.
Strangely for giants, some have been seen at the end of the Varrock sewers.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Pyrefiends

pages.x: Pyrefiends are magical beings of fire and molten rock. They're quick and agile so try attacking them with a crossbow and bolts.
You can find some fiends in the Rellekka Slayer Caves.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Rock slugs

pages.x: Rock slugs are strange, stoney slugs, many of which have been seen in Rellekka Slayer Cave.
You'll need to fight them until they are close to death, before finishing them off with salt.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Sea snakes

pages.x: Sea snakes are long and slithery, with a venomous bite. The larger ones are more dangerous, so keep an eye on your health.
They live on isles far to the north-west, or, rather, in the sea caves of those isles.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Shades

pages.x: Shades are undead - The town of Mort'ton in Morytania is plagued by these creatures, so help if you can.
There are some shades in the Stronghold of Security too, but you won't learn much from fighting those; stick to Mort'ton.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Turoths

pages.x: Turoths are large, vicious creatures with thick hides. You'll need a leaf-bladed weapon, broad arrows or a magic dart to harm them.
You can find a nest of them in the Rellekka Slayer Caves.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Banshees

pages.x: Banshees use a piercing scream to shock their enemies. You'll need some earmuffs to protect yourself from them.
Head to the Slayer Tower near Canifis to slay them, although I have heard rumours of tougher banshees in Pollnivneach.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Basilisks

pages.x: Basilisks, like cockatrices, have a gaze that will paralyse and harm their prey. You'll need a mirror shield to protect you.
I am sure you know that there is a Basilisk colony in the Rellekka Slayer Caves.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Blue dragons

pages.x: Blue dragons aren't as strong as other dragons, but they're still very powerful. Watch out for their fiery breath.
Taverley Dungeon has a clutch of these creatures, which it can be profitable to slay.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Brine rats

pages.x: Brine rats can be found in caves that are near the sea. They are hairless, bad-tempered and generally unfriendly.
You may have spotted them while looking for pirate treasures.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Bronze dragons

pages.x: Bronze dragons are the weakest of the metallic dragons, but their bronze scales are far thicker than normal bronze armour.
They lay in wait for you in Brimhaven Dungeon and the Chaos Tunnels. You'll be well served by taking a defence against their breath.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Cave crawlers

pages.x: Cave crawlers are small and fast, often hiding in ambush. Avoid their barbed tongue or you'll get poisoned.
Squish them in droves at the Rellekka Slayer Dungeon near the golden tree.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Cave horrors

pages.x: Cave horrors can be found in the caves under Mos Le'Harmless which favour the use of missiles or Magic. You will need a witchwood icon to fight them effectively.
They drop the famous black Slayer mask, so the trip may be worth it.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Dagannoth

pages.x: Dagannoth are large, sea-dwelling creatures that are very aggressive. You'll often find them in caves near sea water.
I can tell that you've seen the vile creatures, so you know where to go. Remember: they attack with missiles, so protect yourself accordingly.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Dust devils

pages.x: Dust devils use clouds of dust, sand, ash and whatever else they can inhale to blind and disorientate their victims.
They typically lurk in the smoky dungeon west of Pollnivneach.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Elves

pages.x: Elves are quick, agile, and vicious fighters who often favour bows and polearms. They also irritate me intensely, so slaughtering them is definitely a good thing.
They live in the forests far, far to the west of human lands.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Fever spiders

pages.x: Fever spiders are giant spiders that carry the deadly spider fever. If you don't want to catch it, I suggest you wear Slayer gloves to fight them.
I've heard they cause problems in breweries, if you want to find some.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Fire giants

pages.x: Like other giants, Fire giants often wield large weapons. Learn to recognise what kind of weapon it is and act accordingly.
The smoke dungeon to the west of Pollnivneach has a population of these large and irritating creatures, so go smite them.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Gargoyles

pages.x: Gargoyles are winged creatures of stone. You'll need to fight them until they are close to death before breaking them apart with a rock hammer.
There is a thriving population of Gargoyles in the Slayer Tower near Canifis.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Harpie bug swarms

pages.x: Harpie bugs are pesky critters that are hard to hit. You need a lit bug lantern to distract them with its hypnotic light.
They live on Karamja, near the coast, and just south-east of the narrow stretch of land which joins the two halves of the island.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Jellies

pages.x: Jellies are nasty, cube-like, gelatinous creatures which absorb everything they come across. Rellekka's caves are known to harbour these unnatural abominations.
You can consider their attacks to be a form of Ranged and protect yourself with this in mind.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Jungle strykewyrms

pages.x: These tricky creatures burrow beneath the jungle north west of Oo'glog.
Be careful, as these poisonous jungle wyrms like to use magical attacks from a distance, while they should be weak to stab attacks.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Kalphites

pages.x: Kalphites are large insects that live in hives under the desert sands. South-west of Shantay Pass they swarm and make themselves a nuisance.
Enter deeper into the lair if you are looking for a suitable challenge.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Kurasks

pages.x: Kurasks are large, brutal creatures with very thick hides. You'll need a leaf-bladed weapon, broad arrows or a magic dart to harm them.
Kurask may be found in the caverns east of Rellekka. As they are so large, you may be able to kill them when they cannot reach you.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Mutated zygomites

pages.x: Mutated zygomites are hard to destroy and attack with mainly magical damage. They regenerate quickly, so you will need to finish them off with fungicide.
We have a bit of a problem with them here in Zanaris.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Trolls

pages.x: Trolls regenerate quickly but are still vulnerable to poisons. They usually use crushing weapons.
Perhaps you should head to the snowy islands where these creatures are both fierce and aggressive.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Turoths

pages.x: Turoths are large, vicious creatures with thick hides. You'll need a leaf-bladed weapon, broad arrows, or a magic dart to harm them.
Seek them out in the Rellekka Slayer Caves.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Vyrewatch

pages.x: These foul creatures can be found throughout Meiyerditch and Darkmeyer in Morytania.
They have a telepathic ability which enables them to dodge incoming attacks, so you'll need a weapon specially created to harm them.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Abyssal demons

pages.x: Abyssal demons are nasty creatures to deal with. They aren't really part of this realm and are able to move very quickly to trap their prey.
The Slayer Tower is home to a number of these creatures.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Black dragons

pages.x: Black dragons are among the strongest dragons and are very fierce. Watch out for their fiery breath.
I am sure you will have seen them in your travels and have honed your techniques on lesser dragons.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Bloodveld

pages.x: Bloodveld are strange, demonic creatures. They use their long, rasping tongue to feed on just about anything they can find.
Remember that their tongues are magical in nature but, moreso, they deserve to die.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Celestial dragons

pages.x: Celestial dragons are one of the strangest dragons I assign. They use melee but have a powerful dragonfire as well as a fascinating ability to momentarily stop time.
You can find them in the depths of Dragontooth Island.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Dagannoth

pages.x: Dagannoth are large, sea-dwelling creatures that are very aggressive. You'll often find them in caves near sea water.
There is no joy so great as to cleanse these from the face of Gielinor.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Dark beasts

pages.x: Dark beasts are large, dog-like predators with massively muscled bodies that protect them from crushing weapons.
You'll find them near the Temple of Light, attracted to the power of the Death Altar.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Dust devils

pages.x: Dust devils use clouds of dust, sand, ash and whatever else they can inhale to blind and disorientate their victims.
Good luck on obtaining a dragon chainmail from their dusty remains.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Edimmu

pages.x: Edimmu are ghosts which failed to escape their body. They're ghosts and zombies, yet somehow different altogether. They use ranged attacks and are highly aggressive.
You can find them in a resource dungeon, which the Meilyr clan in Prifddinas has access to.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Fire giants

pages.x: Like other giants, Fire giants often wield large weapons. Learn to recognise what kind of weapon it is and act accordingly.
Remember the days when these were a challenge to you, and laugh.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Gargoyles

pages.x: Gargoyles are winged creatures of stone. You'll need to fight them until they are close to death before breaking them apart with a rock hammer.
Exterminate those in the Slayer Tower.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Goraks

pages.x: Goraks are extremely aggressive creatures. They have been imprisoned on an alternate plane, which is only accessible by using the fairy rings.
Be extremely careful: their touch drains life points as well as skills!

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Greater demons

pages.x: Greater demons are weak to ranged attacks. Though not the strongest of the demons, they are still dangerous.
Slaughter them easily in Brimhaven's depths, and revel in your power.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Ice strykewyrms

pages.x: The strongest and coldest of their kind, they are found beneath the Fremennik mountains.
Be careful of all their attacks; but, as they are beings of ice, I've found my fire spells inflict far more damage against them.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Jungle strykewyrms

pages.x: These tricky creatures burrow beneath the jungle north west of Oo'glog.
Be careful, as these poisonous jungle wyrms like to use magical attacks from a distance, while they should be weak to stab attacks.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Mithril dragons

pages.x: Mithril dragons are very dangerous opponents. They live beneath the Baxtorian Falls and devour most of those who seek to slay them.
You are a battlemaster; test your skills.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Mutated jadinkos

pages.x: These warped jade vine creatures will not hesitate to use their environment to help them in combat if they cannot retaliate otherwise.
The baby jadinkos are easiest to kill, but the males offer the greatest rewards. Ranged weapons made from vines are best against them.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Order of ascension members

pages.x: The Order of Ascension are magic users. It is strongly suggested you use ranged attacks.
Their tactics can make them tough one-on-one, so bringing a friend along would be beneficial.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Scabarites

pages.x: Scabarites are the followers of Scabaras and consist of anything from the lowliest dung beetle to the mightiest scarab mage.
They are most commonly found near Sophanem, and under it.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Skeletal wyverns

pages.x: Skeletal wyverns are extremely dangerous and they are hard to hit with arrows, as they slip right through.
To stand a good chance of surviving, you'll need some elemental shielding from their icy breath.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Spiritual mages

pages.x: Spiritual mages are the strongest of the spiritual guardians. They are devastating against warriors, but a smart ranger can sometimes defeat them.
Of course, Prayer might serve you well, too. They can be found in the icy caverns near Trollheim, supporting the cause of their chosen god.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Steel dragons

pages.x: Steel dragons are dangerous and metallic, with steel scales that are far thicker than normal steel armour.
As you are an accomplished slayer, I am sure you'll be able to deal with them easily.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Vyrewatch

pages.x: These foul creatures can be found throughout Meiyerditch and Darkmeyer in Morytania.
They have a telepathic ability which enables them to dodge incoming attacks, so you'll need a weapon specially created to harm them.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Warped terrorbirds

pages.x: Warped terrorbirds are creatures tainted by magical waste and are vulnerable to an elven chime and may only be damaged when a chime has been used; look carefully to work out which.
Their sonic attack is a Ranged attack but may be affected by ear defences.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Birds

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Cave slime

pages.x: Cave slimes are the lesser cousins of jellies. Don't be fooled, though: they can still be dangerous, as they're often poisonous.
Killing the ones beneath Lumbridge Swamp might be a good start.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Frogs

pages.x: Frogs will attack and move faster than the average human, but on the whole an experienced warrior can deal with a lot of them quite quickly.
You can find them in the swamp to the south.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Goblins

pages.x: Goblins are mostly just annoying, but they can be vicious. Watch out for the weapons they sometimes carry.
You can find them on the east side of the river here in Lumbridge.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Rats

pages.x: Rats come in different sizes if you want a challenge or not.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Aberrant spectres

pages.x: Aberrant spectres are fetid, vile ghosts. The very smell of them will paralyse and harm you. A nosepeg will help ignore their stink when fighting them.
They can be found in the Slayer Tower near Canifis and I have heard rumours that they also live beneath Pollnivneach in the desert.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Abyssal demons

pages.x: Abyssal demons are nasty creatures to deal with. They aren't really part of this realm and are able to move very quickly to trap their prey.
I've managed to trap a few in the dungeon I'm guarding.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Acheron mammoths

pages.x: Acheron Mammoths are honourable yet powerful beasts from the frozen north. When they charge you, get out of the way!
They can be found on an iceberg that is accessible from a dock near Rellekka.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Ascension members

pages.x: The Order of Ascension are magic users. It is strongly suggested you use ranged attacks.
Their tactics can make them tough one-on-one, so bringing a friend along would be beneficial.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Black dragons

pages.x: Black dragons are among the strongest dragons and are very fierce. Watch out for their fiery breath.
I am sure you will have seen them in your travels and have honed your techniques on lesser dragons.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Bloodveld

pages.x: Bloodvelds are strange, demonic creatures. They use their long, rasping tongue to feed on just about anything they can find.
Remember that their tongues are magical in nature, but, more so, they deserve to die.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Camel warriors

pages.x: Camel warriors can use ancient magics to attack you. They also have the blessings of Akthanakos and can create powerful, disorientating mirages.
They can be found in the deep desert.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Celestial dragons

pages.x: Celestial dragons are one of the strangest dragons I assign. They use melee but have a powerful dragonfire as well as a fascinating ability to momentarily stop time.
You can find them in the depths of Dragontooth Island.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Chaos giants

pages.x: You can find Chaos giants out in the Barendir tunnels, beyond Keldagrim.
Be careful, as they can launch their Dragon throwing axe at range or take a swipe at you if you get close. Perhaps you could recover some.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Dagannoth

pages.x: Dagannoth are large, sea-dwelling creatures that are very aggressive. You'll often find them in caves near sea water.
There is no joy so great as to cleanse these from the face of Gielinor.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Dust devils

pages.x: Dust devils use clouds of dust, sand, ash and whatever else they can inhale to blind and disorientate their victims.
Good luck on obtaining a dragon chainmail from their dusty remains.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Edimmu

pages.x: Edimmu are ghosts which failed to escape their body. They're ghosts and zombies, yet somehow different altogether. They use ranged attacks and are highly aggressive.
You can find them in a resource dungeon, which the Meilyr clan in Prifddinas has access to.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Fire giants

pages.x: Like other giants, fire giants often wield large weapons. Learn to recognise what kind of weapon it is and act accordingly.
Remember the days when these were a challenge to you and laugh.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Gargoyles

pages.x: Gargoyles are winged creatures of stone. You'll need to fight them until they are close to death before breaking them apart with a rock hammer.
I've managed to trap a few in the dungeon I'm guarding.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Iron dragons

pages.x: Iron dragons are some of the weaker metallic dragons, with iron scales that are far thicker than normal iron armour.
Their fiery breath and sharp claws can be negated by a number of means. I've managed to trap a few in the dungeon I'm guarding.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Jungle strykewyrms

pages.x: These tricky creatures burrow beneath the jungle north west of Oo'glog.
Be careful, as these poisonous jungle wyrms like to use magical attacks from a distance, while they should be weak to stab attacks.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Kal'gerion demons

pages.x: Kal'gerion demons are powerful creatures that use both magic and melee. They reside in a storage dungeon near Daemonheim.
I would recommend you take cover when they smash the ground, or when they use magic to pull you towards them.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Lava strykewyrms

pages.x: Lava strykewyrms are the most powerful of their kind. They attack with all combat styles and are weak to nothing.
They can be found deep within the Wilderness so I would watch your back while slaying them.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Living wyverns

pages.x: Living wyverns breathe a poison that will kill you rapidly unless you are freezing. But watch out; the colder you are the harder their regular attacks will hit you.
They can be found in the Asgarnia Ice dungeon.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Muspah

pages.x: Muspah are creatures born of nightmares. Ancient magic is the most effective thing to use against them. You can find them by travelling to Freneskae.
They'll be aggressive unless you wear your shard of Zaros.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Mutated jadinkos

pages.x: These warped jade vine creatures will not hesitate to use their environment to help them in combat if they cannot retaliate otherwise.
The baby jadinkos are easiest to kill, but the males offer the greatest rewards. Ranged weapons made from vines are best against them.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Nihil

pages.x: The surviving subjects of Zaros's experiments. They have powerful charge attacks and fight in packs of four. You can find them by travelling to Freneskae.
They'll be aggressive unless you wear your shard of Zaros.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Ripper demons

pages.x: Ripper Demons are driven crazy by the scent of blood. They will hit you harder the worse your injuries are.
And watch out; they can sometimes drop on you from above, which is lethal. They can be found in a fissure near Al Kharid.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Skeletal wyverns

pages.x: Skeletal wyverns are extremely dangerous, and they are hard to hit with arrows as they slip right through.
To stand a good chance of surviving, you'll need some elemental shielding from their icy breath.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Spiritual mages

pages.x: Spiritual mages are the strongest of the spiritual guardians. They are devastating against warriors, but a smart ranger can sometimes defeat them.
Of course, Prayer might serve you well, too. They can be found in the icy caverns near Trollheim, supporting the cause of their chosen god.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Tormented demons

pages.x: Tormented demons are powerful creatures that use magic, ranged and melee attacks. They also have the ability to shield themselves.
You can find them below the Tears of Guthix cave.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Vyrewatch

pages.x: These foul creatures can be found throughout Meiyerditch and Darkmeyer in Morytania.
They have a telepathic ability which enables them to dodge incoming attacks, so you'll need a weapon specially created to harm them.

conversations.section: Assignement advice / Greater demons

pages.x: Greater demons are weak to ranged attacks. Though not the strongest of the demons, they are still dangerous.
Slaughter them easily in Brimhaven's depths, and revel in your power.

conversations.section: Assignement advice / Ice strykewyrms

pages.x: The strongest and coldest of their kind, they are found beneath the Fremennik mountains.
Be careful of all their attacks; but, as they are beings of ice, I've found my fire spells inflict far more damage against them.

As you are an accomplished slayer, I am sure you'll be able to deal with them easily.

Their sonic attack is a Ranged attack but may be affected by ear defences.

conversations.section: Attempting to climb-down the champion statue with a follower

pages.x: Sorry, but I'm not going to let you down there with that follower.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Abyssal demons

pages.x: Abyssal demons are nasty creatures to deal with. They aren't really part of this realm and are able to move very quickly to trap their prey.
They can be found south of the Lava Maze.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Gargoyles

pages.x: Gargoyles are winged creatures of stone. You'll need to fight them until they are close to death before breaking them apart with a rock hammer.
They can be found in the eastern ruins, north of the Graveyard of Shadows.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Kal'gerion demons

pages.x: Kal'gerion demons are powerful creatures that use both magic and melee. They reside near the Demonic Ruins.
I would recommend you take cover when they smash the ground, or when they use magic to pull you towards them.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Lava strykewyrms

pages.x: Lava strykewyrms are the most powerful of their kind. They attack with all combat styles and are weak to nothing.
They can be found deep within the Wilderness to the south-west of the Lava Maze. I would watch your back while slaying them.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Living wyverns

pages.x: Living wyverns breathe a poison that will kill you rapidly unless you are freezing. But watch out; the colder you are the harder their regular attacks will hit you.
They can be found in the snow west of here.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Revenant ghosts

pages.x: Revenant ghosts range from ghostly imps to dragons, they are all very powerful. They have the ability to heal themselves, so make sure you're prepared!
These ghosts reside in the Forinthry Dungeon.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Ripper demons

pages.x: Ripper Demons are driven crazy by the scent of blood. They will hit you harder the worse your injuries are.
And watch out - they can sometimes drop on you from above, which is lethal. They can be found north of Red Dragon Isle.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Aberrant spectres

pages.x: Aberrant spectres are fetid, vile ghosts. The very smell of them will paralyse and harm you.
A nosepeg will help you ignore their stink and make you fight at full capacity. Sniff them out in the Slayer Tower in Morytania.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Basilisks

pages.x: Basilisks, like cockatrices, have a gaze which will paralyse and harm their prey. You'll need a mirror shield to protect you.
Basilisks live in the Rellekka Slayer Caves, along with their cockatrice relatives.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Bloodvelds

pages.x: Bloodveld are strange, demonic creatures that use their long, rasping tongue to feed on just about anything they can find.
If you wish to slay some, they live in the Slayer Tower to the north-west of Canifis.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Brine rats

pages.x: Brine rats can be found in caves near to the sea. They are hairless, bad-tempered and generally unfriendly.
If you have found Olaf's pirate treasure, you'll know where to find these targets.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Cockatrices

pages.x: Cockatrices, like basilisks, have a gaze which will paralyse and harm their prey. You'll need a mirror shield to protect you.
If you are brave enough, head to Slayer Caves east of Rellekka.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Crocodiles

pages.x: Crocodiles are large reptiles that live in the Kharidian Desert near water.
River crocodiles are a bigger challenge than the ones found next to the ocean in the south east.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Desert lizards

pages.x: Desert lizards are large reptiles with tough skin. They're cold-blooded, so dousing them with freezing water will finish them off after a tough battle.
You can find them to the east of Sophanem.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Grotworms

pages.x: Grotworms have recently been spotted in a cave near Rimmington.
The younger specimens haven't fully developed their mandibles yet, and will attack with some sort of acid spit.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Infernal mages

pages.x: Infernal mages are dangerous spell users; beware of their Magic spells and go properly prepared.
They have taken over an area upstairs in the Slayer Tower, plotting your doom.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Lesser demons

pages.x: Lesser demons are magic creatures, so they are weak to ranged attacks. Although they're relatively weak, they are still dangerous.
Taverley Dungeon is home to these foul creatures.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Molanisks

pages.x: Molanisks are subterranean creatures. You can find them in caves deep below the ground.
I heard that the goblins have recently had trouble with some, but they use a bell to lure them from the cave wall.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Pyrefiends

pages.x: Pyrefiends are magical beings of fire and molten rock. They're quick and agile so try attacking them with a crossbow and bolts.
You can find some fiends in the Rellekka Slayer Caves.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Rock slugs

pages.x: Rock slugs are strange, stoney slugs, many of which have been seen in Rellekka Slayer Cave.
You'll need to fight them until they are close to death, before finishing them off with salt.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Sea snakes

pages.x: Sea snakes are long and slithery, with a venomous bite. The larger ones are more dangerous, so keep an eye on your health.
They live on isles far to the north-west, or, rather, in the sea caves of those isles.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Shades

pages.x: Shades are undead - The town of Mort'ton in Morytania is plagued by these creatures, so help if you can.
There are some shades in the Stronghold of Security too, but you won't learn much from fighting those; stick to Mort'ton.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Turoths

pages.x: Turoths are large, vicious creatures with thick hides. You'll need a leaf-bladed weapon, broad arrows or a magic dart to harm them.
You can find a nest of them in the Rellekka Slayer Caves.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Abyssal demons

pages.x: Abyssal demons are nasty creatures to deal with. They aren't really part of this realm and are able to move very quickly to trap their prey.
They can be found in Canifis Slayer Tower and in the Senntisten Asylum.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Acheron mammoths

pages.x: Acheron Mammoths are honourable yet powerful beasts from the frozen north. When they charge you, get out of the way!
They can be found on an iceberg that is accessible from a dock near Rellekka.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Black dragons

pages.x: Black dragons are among the strongest dragons and are very fierce. Watch out for their fiery breath.
I am sure you will have seen them in your travels and have honed your techniques on lesser dragons.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Camel warriors

pages.x: Camel warriors can use ancient magics to attack you. They also have the blessings of Akthanakos and can create powerful, disorientating mirages.
They can be found in the deep desert.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Chaos giants

pages.x: You can find Chaos giants out in the Barendir tunnels, beyond Keldagrim.
Be careful, as they can launch their Dragon throwing axe at range or take a swipe at you if you get close. Perhaps you could recover some.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Crystal shapeshifters

pages.x: Crystal shapeshifters are deranged remnants of the elves on Tarddiad. They are quite mad and, according to Angof, beyond redemption.
Show them mercy by ending their suffering.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Dagannoth

pages.x: Dagannoth are large, sea-dwelling creatures that are very aggressive. You'll often find them in caves near sea water.
There is no joy so great as to cleanse these from the face of Gielinor.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Dark beasts

pages.x: Dark beasts are large, dog-like predators with massively muscled bodies that protect them from crushing weapons.
We found some while mining the Mourner tunnels, in search of the Temple of Light.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Edimmu

pages.x: Edimmu are ghosts which failed to escape their body. They're ghosts and zombies, yet somehow different altogether. They use ranged attacks and are highly aggressive.
You can find them in a resource dungeon, which the Meilyr clan in Prifddinas has access to.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Elves

pages.x: I'm not advocating the killing of my kind, you understand - we enjoy being tested in combat.
You'll find melee fighters in Clan Iorwerth's segment of Prifddinas; mages and rangers in Clan Cadarn's segment.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Gargoyles

pages.x: Gargoyles are winged creatures of stone. You'll need to fight them until they are close to death before breaking them apart with a rock hammer.
They can be found in Canifis Slayer Tower.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Iron dragons

pages.x: Iron dragons are some of the weaker metallic dragons, with iron scales that are far thicker than normal iron armour.
Their fiery breath and sharp claws can be negated by a number of means. Look for them in Brimhaven Dungeon.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Kal'gerion demons

pages.x: Kal'gerion demons are powerful creatures that use both magic and melee. They reside in a resource dungeon near Daemonheim.
I would recommend you take cover when they smash the ground, or when they use magic to pull you towards them.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Lava strykewyrms

pages.x: Lava strykewyrms are the most powerful of their kind. They attack with all combat styles and are weak to nothing.
They can be found deep within the Wilderness so I would watch your back while slaying them.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Living wyverns

pages.x: Living wyverns breathe a poison that will kill you rapidly unless you are freezing. But watch out; the colder you are the harder their regular attacks will hit you.
They can be found in the Asgarnia Ice dungeon.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Muspah

pages.x: Muspah are creatures born of nightmares. Ancient magic is the most effective thing to use against them. You can find them by travelling to Freneskae.
They'll be aggressive unless you wear your shard of Zaros.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Mutated jadinkos

pages.x: These warped jade vine creatures will not hesitate to use their environment to help them in combat if they cannot retaliate otherwise.
The baby jadinkos are easiest to kill, but the males offer the greatest rewards. Ranged weapons made from vines are best against them.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Nihil

pages.x: The surviving subjects of Zaros's experiments. They have powerful charge attacks and fight in packs of four. You can find them by travelling to Freneskae.
They'll be aggressive unless you wear your shard of Zaros.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Nodon dragonkin

pages.x: Nodon dragonkin are deeply intelligent creatures, armed with advanced siege weaponry. However, they are weak to dragonbane weapons.
You can find them fighting for Jas in Senntisten.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Order of ascension members

pages.x: The Order of Ascension are magic users. It is strongly suggested you use ranged attacks.
Their tactics can make them tough one-on-one, so bringing a friend along would be beneficial.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Ripper demons

pages.x: Ripper Demons are driven crazy by the scent of blood. They will hit you harder the worse your injuries are.
And watch out; they can sometimes drop on you from above, which is lethal. They can be found in a fissure near Al Kharid.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Rune dragons

pages.x: Rune dragons are even more dangerous than adamant dragons. I highly recommend you bring dragonbane ammunition to pierce their armour.
To find them, you must travel to Kethsi via the World Gate in Arandar.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Shadow creatures

pages.x: Shadows are light creatures that have been corrupted by the Dark Lord.
The Amlodd summon them to their section of the city in order to defeat them and then cleanse their cores.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Tormented demons

pages.x: Tormented demons are powerful creatures that use magic, ranged and melee attacks. They also have the ability to shield themselves.
You can find them below the Tears of Guthix cave.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Vyrewatch

pages.x: These foul creatures can be found throughout Meiyerditch and Darkmeyer in Morytania.
They have a telepathic ability which enables them to dodge incoming attacks, so you'll need a weapon specially created to harm them.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Aberrant spectres

pages.x: Aberrant spectres are fetid, vile ghosts. The very smell of them will paralyse and harm you, while a nosepeg will help ignore their stink.
If you sniff carefully, you may be able to detect their aroma beneath the town's well. Kill a few of them, as they offend my nose.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Abyssal demons

pages.x: Abyssal demons are nasty creatures to deal with. They aren't really part of this realm and are able to move very quickly to trap their prey.
I'm sure you'd love a nice abyssal whip or two, so cull these demons in the Slayer Tower near Canifis.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Banshees

pages.x: Banshees use a piercing scream to shock their enemies, so you'll need some earmuffs to protect yourself.
I am sometimes disturbed in my sleep by their wails, so do me a favour and thin out those beneath us.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Basilisks

pages.x: Basilisks, like Cockatrices, have a gaze which will paralyse and harm their prey. You'll need a mirror shield to protect you.
Conveniently, you can have some combat fun with these brutes in the dungeon beneath the town well.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Black demons

pages.x: Black demons are creatures that are weak to ranged attacks. They're the strongest type of demon and are therefore very dangerous.
Prove yourself more dangerous by slaying these demons in their lairs beneath Taverley or Edgeville.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Blue dragons

pages.x: Blue dragons aren't as strong as other dragons, but they're still very powerful. Watch out for their fiery breath!
Taverley is home to these pests - I'm sure you'll enjoy murdering a few.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Cave crawlers

pages.x: Cave crawlers are small and fast, often hiding in ambush. Avoid their barbed tongue or you'll get poisoned.
The ones in the caves below here have grown large and fat in blissful isolation - go and be a force of natural selection.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Cave horrors

pages.x: Cave horrors can be found under Mos Le'Harmless. You will need a witchwood icon to fight them effectively.
If you want to make a nice Slayer helmet, you'll need the black mask they drop.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Crocodiles

pages.x: Crocodiles are large reptiles that live near water. You'll want to have a stabbing weapon handy for puncturing their thick, scaly hides.
These are desert beasts, so seek them there.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Dagannoth

pages.x: Dagannoth are large, sea-dwelling creatures that are very aggressive. You'll often find them in caves near sea water.
You'll cackle with glee if you set up a cannon and massacre them.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Dust devils

pages.x: Dust devils use clouds of dust, sand, ash and whatever else they can inhale to blind and disorientate their victims.
You'll be able to test your skills on them in the smoky dungeon to the west. Get going!

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Elves

pages.x: Elves are quick, agile and vicious fighters that often favour bows, polearms and snide remarks.
Their dedication to trees, bushes and music is an affront to me, so go and cause havoc in their vile villages. You'll need to travel far to the west.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Fire giants

pages.x: Like other giants, Fire giants often wield large weapons. Learn to recognise what kind of weapon it is and act accordingly.
Prove that bigger isn't always better by defeating some. They lurk in the smoke dungeon, west of here, telling tales of your weakness.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Gargoyles

pages.x: Gargoyles are winged creatures of stone. You'll need to fight them until they are close to death, before breaking them apart with a rock hammer.
They refuse to serve me, so smite them in my name. They are hiding out in the Slayer Tower near Canifis.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Greater demons

pages.x: Greater demons are creatures that are weak to ranged attacks. Though not the strongest of demons, they are still dangerous. Prove yourself by doing away with them.
If you don't know, a large number live in the Brimhaven Dungeon.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Hellhounds

pages.x: Hellhounds are a cross between dogs and demons, and are dangerous with a fierce bite. Although they are not cats, they deserve to die anyway.
You'll be doing Gielinor a favour if you slay Hellhounds beneath Taverley.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Iron dragons

pages.x: Iron dragons are some of the weaker metallic dragons, but their iron scales are far thicker than normal iron armour.
Brimhaven Dungeon has a few of these creatures in residence; I think they should be exterminated because they bore me.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Jungle strykewyrms

pages.x: These tricky creatures burrow beneath the jungle north west of Oo'glog.
Be careful, as these poisonous jungle wyrms like to use magical attacks from a distance, while they should be weak to stab attacks.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Kalphites

pages.x: Kalphites are large insects that live in hives under the desert sands. Their Queen is rumoured to be quite powerful.
Show people that you are a force to be feared by slaying her brood in the hive to the north-west.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Kurasks

pages.x: Kurasks are large, brutal creatures with very thick hides. You'll need a leaf-bladed weapon, broad arrows, or a magic dart to harm them.
Unluckily for kurasks, I am sending you to kill them. Luckily for you, kurasks thrive in the dungeons below Pollnivneach.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Mutated jadinkos

pages.x: These warped jade vine creatures will not hesitate to use their environment to help them in combat if they cannot retaliate otherwise.
The baby jadinkos are easiest to kill, but the males offer the greatest rewards. Ranged weapons made from vines are best against them.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Nechryael

pages.x: Nechryael are demons of decay that summon small-winged beings to help them fight their victims. I don't like them much, so kill a few as a personal favour.
You can find them up to no good in the Slayer Tower near Canifis.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Red dragons

pages.x: Red dragons are fearsome firebreathers, stronger than green or blue.
I'm sure that you'll have fun pitting your skills against their claws in either Brimhaven's depths or the ravaged lands far to the north.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Spiritual warriors

pages.x: Spiritual warriors are fighters that have dedicated their souls to their deity; however, they still retain a fighter's weakness to Magic.
They can be found fighting for the god whose cause they support. Kill them all and let their gods lament.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Terror dogs

pages.x: Terror dogs are, unsurprisingly, dogs that terrorise the weak. They are the servants of Tarn, who annoyed me when he was young.
Be a force of vengeance for me by cleaning his lair of these pathetic servitors.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Turoths

pages.x: Turoths are large vicious creatures with thick hides. You'll need a leaf-bladed weapon, broad arrows, or a magic dart to harm them.
I am sure you'll make yourself useful by killing the ones beneath our feet.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Vyrewatch

pages.x: These foul creatures can be found throughout Meiyerditch and Darkmeyer in Morytania.
They have a telepathic ability which enables them to dodge incoming attacks, so you'll need a weapon specially created to harm them.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Bears

pages.x: Bears are tough creatures and fierce fighters, so watch out for their powerful claws. Bears have been spotted west of Gunnarsgrunn near the mysterious ruins.
I heard a rumour of a stronger type of bear down a rift to the east of Varrock.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Cave slime

pages.x: Cave slimes are the lesser cousins of jellies. Don't be fooled, though: they can still be dangerous as they're often poisonous.
You'll do Lumbridge a favour if you kill the slimes in Lumbridge Swamp caves.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Ghosts

pages.x: Ghosts play tricks and japes upon those entering Taverley Dungeon, so put them to rest.
If you are after a bigger challenge you can find some stronger ghosts in the Stronghold of Security.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Hill giants

pages.x: Hill giants use crude weapons or tools so prepare accordingly.
There is a colony of them, deep inside the Edgeville tunnels; all good folk will approve if you clean it out.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Ice giants

pages.x: Like other giants, ice giants often wield large weapons. Try using fire spells to melt them before they can hit you.
Ice giants can be found underground to the south of Port Sarim.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Icefiends

pages.x: Icefiends are beings of ice and freezing rock. They're quick and agile, so you'll want to be careful when getting close to them.
Ice Mountain is infested with these pesky creatures.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Mogres

pages.x: Mogres are a type of aquatic ogre that is often mistaken for a giant mudskipper. You have to force them out of the water with a fishing explosive.
You can find them on the peninsula to the south of Port Sarim.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Moss giants

pages.x: Like other giants, moss giants often wield large weapons. Use fire spells to burn them to cinders before they can damage you.
Strangely for giants, some have been seen at the end of the Varrock sewers.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Spiders

pages.x: Spiders are often venomous and many varieties are camouflaged, too. I've seen plenty to the south-west of Lumbridge.
If you are up for a challenge you can find stronger spiders down in the Stronghold of Security.

conversations.section: Assignment advice / Wall beasts

pages.x: Wall beasts are really much larger creatures, but you'll only see their arms. You'll want something sharp on your head to stop them grabbing you.
The geology of the caves beneath Lumbridge Swamp favours these creatures.
